:root {
  --canvas: #f3f4f1;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-subtle: #f8f9f7;
  --ink: #242c29;
  --muted: #626c66;
  --faint: #79817c;
  --line: #dfe4de;
  --line-strong: #c9d1ca;
  --accent: #216d60;
  --accent-hover: #195448;
  --accent-soft: #edf5f1;
  --accent-bar: #709486;
  --rail: #202925;
  --rail-ink: #eef2ee;
  --rail-muted: #a6b5ad;
  --rail-active: #33473d;
  --rail-border: #3b4840;
  --critical: #af3e35;
  --critical-soft: #fbefed;
  --high: #915b17;
  --high-soft: #fcf3e5;
  --medium: #476785;
  --medium-soft: #eef3f8;
  --low: #616b66;
  --low-soft: #f0f2ef;
  --focus: #216d60;
  --focus-on-dark: #b5deca;
  --body-font: "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, sans-serif;
  --numeric-font: "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  --rail-width: 190px;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-padding-top: 24px; }
body { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--canvas); font: 13px/1.5 var(--body-font); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
button, input, select { font: inherit; }
button, a, input, select, summary { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
button:disabled { cursor: default; }
a { color: inherit; }
button, input, select { border-radius: 4px; }
button, input, select, a, summary { touch-action: manipulation; }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible, [tabindex="-1"]:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
h2 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.15px; }
h3 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
svg { display: block; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.icon-library { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.mono { font-family: var(--numeric-font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; z-index: 10; top: 10px; left: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--accent); transform: translateY(-160%); }
.skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }

.rail { position: fixed; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: var(--rail-width); background: var(--rail); color: var(--rail-ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 29px 16px 18px; z-index: 5; }
.rail a:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus-on-dark); }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0 9px 43px; text-decoration: none; width: fit-content; }
.brand-mark { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 9px); grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 9px); gap: 3px; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
.brand-mark span { background: var(--rail-ink); border-radius: 1px; }
.brand-mark span:nth-child(2) { background: var(--rail-muted); }
.brand-mark span:nth-child(3) { background: var(--accent-bar); }
.brand-name { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -1.4px; line-height: 1; }
.brand-period { color: var(--accent-bar); }
.rail-label { margin: 0 12px 11px; color: var(--rail-muted); font: 9px var(--numeric-font); letter-spacing: 1.4px; }
.rail-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.rail-link { min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--rail-muted); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; }
.rail-link:hover { color: var(--rail-ink); border-color: var(--rail-border); }
.rail-link[aria-current] { color: var(--rail-ink); background: var(--rail-active); border-color: var(--rail-border); }
.rail-link .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.rail-count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--rail-ink); background: var(--rail-border); min-width: 18px; padding: 0 4px; text-align: center; border-radius: 3px; font: 10px/18px var(--numeric-font); }
.rail-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-top: auto; padding: 17px 5px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rail-border); }
.operator-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 29px; height: 29px; border: 1px solid var(--rail-border); color: var(--rail-muted); font: 10px var(--numeric-font); border-radius: 3px; }
.rail-footer strong, .rail-footer div > span { display: block; }
.rail-footer strong { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
.rail-footer div > span { font-size: 9px; color: var(--rail-muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.rail-footer-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; margin-left: auto; background: var(--accent-bar); border-radius: 50%; }

.workspace { margin-left: var(--rail-width); min-width: 0; }
.status-bar { min-height: 61px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 30px; background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.breadcrumb { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
.breadcrumb .icon { width: 11px; height: 11px; color: var(--faint); }
.breadcrumb strong { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); }
.status-bar-end { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; font-size: 11px; }
.critical-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--critical); }
.status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--critical); }
.snapshot-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted); }
.snapshot-label .icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.snapshot-label .mono { padding-left: 8px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 10px; }
main { max-width: 1650px; padding: 24px 30px 0; margin: 0 auto; }
.page-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.eyebrow { font: 9px/1.5 var(--numeric-font); letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: var(--muted); }
.environment { display: inline-block; margin-left: 10px; padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .7px; color: var(--ink); }
h1 { margin-top: 7px; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.7px; }
.page-description { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 6px; }
.page-description > span { padding: 0 6px; color: var(--line-strong); }
.review-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; min-height: 36px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong); }
.review-link .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.review-link:hover { color: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent); }
.noscript-notice { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--high); background: var(--high-soft); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.metric { padding: 15px 22px 14px; min-width: 0; }
.metric + .metric { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
.metric-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.metric-value { font: 28px/1.25 var(--numeric-font); letter-spacing: -1.1px; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }
.metric-unit { color: var(--muted); font-size: 17px; margin-left: 5px; letter-spacing: -.4px; }
.metric-trend { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 9px; }
.metric-change { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--accent); font-family: var(--numeric-font); }
.metric-change.is-caution { color: var(--high); }
.trend-context { color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }

.panel { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface); min-width: 0; }
.panel-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 20px; }
.panel-heading p { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.throughput-panel { margin-bottom: 20px; }
.chart-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
.legend-mark { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--accent-bar); }
.chart-peak { margin-left: 12px; padding-left: 15px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-size: 10px; }
.chart { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: 120px 24px; padding: 4px 22px 0 15px; }
.chart-y-axis { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; padding-right: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; position: relative; top: -6px; height: 132px; }
.chart-plot { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.chart-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; pointer-events: none; }
.chart-grid span { display: block; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); width: 100%; }
.chart-grid span:last-child { border-color: var(--line-strong); }
.chart-bars { height: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(24, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; position: relative; list-style: none; margin: 0 6px; padding: 0; }
.chart-bars li { min-width: 0; height: 100%; }
.chart-bar { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 1px; }
.chart-bar-fill { display: block; width: 100%; background: var(--accent-bar); border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; border: 1px solid transparent; }
.chart-bar[aria-pressed="true"] .chart-bar-fill { background: var(--accent); }
.chart-bar:hover .chart-bar-fill { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); }
.chart-bar:focus-visible { outline-offset: 2px; outline-width: 2px; }
.chart-x-axis { grid-column: 2; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
.chart-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 14px 22px 0 47px; padding-bottom: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.chart-readout { color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--numeric-font); font-size: 10px; }
.chart-readout strong { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }

kbd { font: 9px var(--numeric-font); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 1px 3px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--surface-subtle); }

.hour-values dt { color: var(--muted); }

.incident-workspace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 304px; gap: 20px; align-items: start; }

Evaluation 8.5 / 10 graded blind as submission T

Dense dark console with signals strip, mean-line bar chart, severity chips, sortable columns, detail with assessment/timeline and extra activity and service-health sections. Accessible (no contrast failures) and complete, if somewhat crowded with invented context.

Strengths

  • Filters and sort work; empty state 'No incident matches “zzzqqq”. Widen the filters'
  • Acknowledge disables the button, updates status and announces 'Incident INC-2839 acknowledged by A. Kovač'
  • 0 contrast failures; skip link; aria-sort; roving rows

Weaknesses

  • Many invented panels (activity, service health, impact %) add noise
  • Multi-colour severity legend competes with the accent
Evidence the grader checked
  • probe.js lowContrast 0/242
  • probe2: focusAfterAck TR (kept in table)
  • T-mobile-full.png
  • probe.js/probe2.js (Playwright, 1440x900 and 390x844, served over 127.0.0.1)

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

step-5-preview/11-frontend-operations/RESPONSE.md

Relay — operations control room

A single-page control-room console built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No frameworks, no build step, no external fonts, images, or network requests — the only files needed are index.html, styles.css, and app.js. All content is seeded from DATA.json (metrics, the 24 throughput buckets, the incident list) and is inlined in app.js so the page also works when opened directly from disk (file://), where a fetch() of DATA.json would be blocked.

Hierarchy

The page is a 216 px nav rail + a single scrolling column, so operators always keep the same orienting frame while moving through the data.

  1. Top status bar — region, a live-feed state pill, the incident roll-up (1 critical · 1 high · 2 tracked) and a UTC clock. It answers "what needs me right now?" before any detail is read.
  2. Signals — four metric cards. Each carries the value in large tabular figures, a delta chip with a directional arrow, a short operational note (SLO, budget, drain rate) and a 12-point sparkline for trend context. Colour on the delta is semantic, not decorative: down is good for latency and queue depth, up is bad for error rate, and events/min is neutral — the same arrow shape never implies "good" or "bad" by itself.
  3. Throughput — last 24 hours — a bar chart (inline SVG) with 25k gridlines, a dashed 24 h mean, an explicit peak label, hour axis, and a live readout. Peak and mean are called out so the shape of the day is readable without hovering.
  4. Incidents — the working surface: filters, then a dense sortable table, then the detail panel that holds the response action.
  5. Activity and service health — supporting context, deliberately below the triage surface.

The detail panel is docked beside the table on wide screens (sticky, so it stays with the operator) and stacks below it under 1180 px.

Interaction behaviour

  • Table: rows are selectable with mouse, Enter/Space while a row has focus, and J/K from anywhere. ↑/↓/Home/End move within the table. Selection is marked with a left accent bar, a tinted row and aria-current.
  • Sorting: every column header is a button that toggles direction and sets aria-sort; severity defaults to critical-first, age to newest-first.
  • Filtering: free-text search (id, title, service, owner), a severity segmented control with live counts, and a status select. The result count ("4 of 4 shown") updates in the section header, a "Clear filters" button appears as soon as a filter is active, and the empty state explains what did not match instead of just showing a blank table.
  • Detail panel: severity, id, title, status, service, age, owner, impact, a short assessment, and a chronological timeline. Acknowledge sets the status to acknowledged, stamps the timeline with the operator name and time, disables itself, updates the row badge, the top-bar roll-up and the activity feed, and announces the change in a live region. Assign to me claims an unassigned incident (the primary case in the data: INC-2839). A close button returns to the empty detail state on small screens.
  • Chart: hovering, touch-dragging, or focusing the SVG and pressing ←/→/Home/End moves a cursor, updates the readout, and shows a tooltip. Focus starts on the peak value so the first read is meaningful.
  • Shortcuts: / focuses search, J/K change the selected incident, A acknowledges the selected one, ? opens the shortcut reference, Esc closes it or clears search.
  • Rail: anchors scroll to each section; an IntersectionObserver keeps the active item, aria-current, and the incident count in sync with what is on screen.

Accessibility

  • Semantics first: one h1, h2 per section, real <table> with scoped headers and a caption, <nav>, <main>, <aside>, dl for the metadata pairs, <time> in the timeline. Severity and status are never colour-only — each carries a text label and a shape-coded dot.
  • Keyboard: a skip link jumps past the rail; a visible :focus-visible ring (2 px accent, 2 px offset) on every control; roving tabindex in the table so only the selected row is in the tab order; the chart is reachable as a single stop and read with arrow keys; all actions are reachable without a pointer.
  • Screen readers: an aria-live region announces selection, acknowledgement, assignment, filter clearing, sorting and chart values; the SVG chart also has a visually hidden data table (all 24 hours) and a descriptive label; the shortcuts panel is a labelled dialog; icon-only buttons have sr-only text or aria-labels; metric cards expose their value plus the meaning of the delta.
  • No motion dependence: the live-feed pulse, hover transitions and smooth scrolling are all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
  • Contrast: body text and muted labels on the panel backgrounds sit above 4.5:1, and severity colours are only used for small text or shapes on solid backgrounds so they stay legible.

Responsive behaviour

Width Behaviour
≥ 1181 px Rail + wide table + docked detail panel
≤ 1180 px Service and owner columns collapse out; detail panel moves under the table
≤ 900 px Rail becomes a bottom navigation bar; main content gains bottom padding so it is never hidden under the bar; metrics move to two columns
≤ 720 px Table headers hide and rows become labelled cards (Severity, Service, Age, Owner, Status labels are re-inserted above each value); detail actions become sticky
≤ 420 px Metrics stack to one column; controls take the full width

Verified at 390 px: documentElement.scrollWidth equals the viewport width (378 = 378), no element crosses either edge, and the overflow check across every element reports no offenders. There is no horizontal page scroll and no hidden-by-overflow content.

Files

  • index.html — structure, inline SVG icons, shortcuts dialog.
  • styles.css — design tokens (neutral greys, one blue accent, four severity colours), layout, components, responsive rules.
  • app.js — seeded data, rendering, filtering, sorting, selection, acknowledgement, chart drawing and keyboard behaviour.
  • RESPONSE.md — this document.

step-5-preview/11-frontend-operations/TASK.md

Task 11 — Frontend design: operations control room

Build a polished, responsive single-page operations dashboard called Relay using only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, package installs, external fonts, remote assets, or network requests.

Visual direction: calm, high-density control-room software for expert operators. Use a restrained neutral palette with one purposeful accent, excellent numeric alignment, compact spacing, and clear severity states. Avoid glassmorphism, decorative gradients, giant headings, and excessive rounded cards.

The page must include:

  • A navigation rail and top status bar.
  • Four summary metrics with trend context.
  • A 24-hour throughput visualization made with semantic HTML, CSS, canvas, or inline SVG.
  • A filterable incident table with severity, service, age, owner, and status.
  • A detail panel for the selected incident and a working acknowledge action.
  • Useful empty/filter states and visible keyboard focus.
  • A mobile layout that remains usable at 390 px without horizontal page scroll.

Seed realistic content from DATA.json. Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the hierarchy, interaction behavior, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

step-5-preview/11-frontend-operations/app.js

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var OPERATOR = "A. Kovač";

  var SEED = {
    metrics: [
      { label: "Events / min", value: "18,420", change: "+8.2%", direction: "up", better: "none", sub: "peak 21.4k" },
      { label: "P95 latency", value: "184 ms", change: "−12 ms", direction: "down", better: "down", sub: "SLO 250 ms" },
      { label: "Error rate", value: "0.37%", change: "+0.08 pp", direction: "up", better: "down", sub: "budget 12% left" },
      { label: "Queue depth", value: "2,841", change: "−19%", direction: "down", better: "down", sub: "drain 41/s" }
    ],
    throughput: [31, 28, 24, 22, 20, 23, 34, 48, 62, 71, 76, 73, 68, 72, 80, 84, 79, 75, 82, 88, 77, 63, 52, 41],
    incidents: [
      {
        id: "INC-2841", severity: "critical", service: "payments-api", age: "12m", owner: "M. Chen",
        status: "investigating", title: "Card authorization timeouts", minutes: 12, affected: "1.2% of checkouts",
        summary: "Authorization calls to the primary PSP are timing out after 5 s. Retries are amplifying load and the circuit breaker has not yet tripped.",
        events: [
          { at: "12m ago", who: "pagerduty", what: "Page fired on 5xx ratio > 2% for payments-api" },
          { at: "10m ago", who: "M. Chen", what: "Declared incident, escalated to bridge 4431" },
          { at: "7m ago", who: "synthetics", what: "EU checkout probe failing at tokenize step" },
          { at: "3m ago", who: "M. Chen", what: "Ruled out deploy rollback — started 40 min pre-release" }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "INC-2839", severity: "high", service: "event-router", age: "31m", owner: "Unassigned",
        status: "open", title: "EU retry queue growth", minutes: 31, affected: "8.4k messages",
        summary: "The EU retry queue is growing at roughly 90 msg/s because downstream consumers are rejecting with backpressure. No data loss observed.",
        events: [
          { at: "31m ago", who: "monitor", what: "Queue depth alert at 5k messages" },
          { at: "22m ago", who: "monitor", what: "Consumer lag 14 min, rejecting with 503" },
          { at: "9m ago", who: "runbook", what: "Suggested check: shard rebalance for eu-rt-2" }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "INC-2837", severity: "medium", service: "search-index", age: "1h 08m", owner: "A. Silva",
        status: "monitoring", title: "Index freshness outside SLO", minutes: 68, affected: "catalogue reads",
        summary: "Replication lag has pushed index freshness past the 120 s SLO. Search results may omit very recent catalogue changes.",
        events: [
          { at: "1h 08m ago", who: "monitor", what: "Freshness SLO breach (180 s)" },
          { at: "44m ago", who: "A. Silva", what: "Paused backfill job to free write capacity" },
          { at: "18m ago", who: "A. Silva", what: "Lag recovering, moved to monitoring" }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "INC-2832", severity: "low", service: "webhooks", age: "3h 42m", owner: "R. Patel",
        status: "open", title: "Elevated partner delivery lag", minutes: 222, affected: "3 partners",
        summary: "Outbound webhook delivery lag is 4–6 min for three partners. All deliveries eventually succeed within the retry window.",
        events: [
          { at: "3h 42m ago", who: "monitor", what: "Delivery p95 above 240 s" },
          { at: "2h 10m ago", who: "R. Patel", what: "Notified partner success contacts" }
        ]
      }
    ],
    services: [
      { name: "payments-api", note: "auth p95 5.1 s", burn: 92, state: "breach" },
      { name: "event-router", note: "consumer lag 14m", burn: 61, state: "warn" },
      { name: "search-index", note: "freshness 180 s", burn: 38, state: "warn" },
      { name: "webhooks", note: "delivery p95 4.2 m", burn: 17, state: "ok" },
      { name: "edge-gateway", note: "5xx 0.04%", burn: 6, state: "ok" },
      { name: "billing-jobs", note: "on schedule", burn: 3, state: "ok" }
    ]
  };

  var SEV_ORDER = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2, low: 3 };
  var STATUS_ORDER = { open: 0, investigating: 1, monitoring: 2, acknowledged: 3 };
  var STATUS_LABEL = { open: "Open", investigating: "Investigating", monitoring: "Monitoring", acknowledged: "Acknowledged" };

  var state = {
    incidents: SEED.incidents.map(function (i) { return Object.assign({}, i); }),
    severity: "all",
    status: "all",
    query: "",
    sortKey: "severity",
    sortDir: "desc",
    selectedId: SEED.incidents[0].id,
    chartIndex: null
  };

  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

  function mulberry32(a) {
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  function svg(tag, attrs) {
    var n = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag);
    for (var k in attrs) { if (attrs[k] !== null && attrs[k] !== undefined) n.setAttribute(k, String(attrs[k])); }
    return n;
  }

  function arrow(direction) {
    return direction === "up"
      ? '<svg class="delta-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5l7 9h-14z"/></svg>'
      : '<svg class="delta-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19l-7-9h14z"/></svg>';
  }

  function toneFor(m) {
    if (m.better === "none" || m.direction === "flat") { return "flat"; }
    return m.direction === m.better ? "good" : "bad";
  }

  function toneWord(t) { return t === "good" ? "improving" : t === "bad" ? "degrading" : "unchanged"; }

  function sparkline(seedValues, width, height) {
    var min = Math.min.apply(null, seedValues);
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, seedValues);
    var span = max - min || 1;
    var step = width / (seedValues.length - 1);
    var pts = seedValues.map(function (v, i) {
      var x = (i * step).toFixed(1);
      var y = (height - 2 - ((v - min) / span) * (height - 4)).toFixed(1);
      return x + "," + y;
    }).join(" ");
    var s = svg("svg", { class: "metric-spark", viewBox: "0 0 " + width + " " + height, width: width, height: height, "aria-hidden": "true", focusable: "false" });
    s.appendChild(svg("polyline", { points: pts, fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", "stroke-width": 1.4, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round", opacity: 0.9 }));
    var last = pts.split(" ").pop().split(",");
    s.appendChild(svg("circle", { cx: last[0], cy: last[1], r: 1.9, fill: "currentColor" }));
    return s;
  }

  function renderMetrics() {
    var grid = $("metricGrid");
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    SEED.metrics.forEach(function (m, i) {
      var rnd = mulberry32(1000 + i * 77);
      var series = [];
      for (var k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
        var drift = m.direction === "up" ? k * 0.05 : -k * 0.05;
        series.push(0.5 + drift + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.26);
      }
      var tone = toneFor(m);
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = "metric";
      li.setAttribute("aria-label", m.label + " " + m.value + ", " + m.change + " " + toneWord(tone) + ". " + m.sub);
      li.innerHTML =
        '<div class="metric-top"><span class="metric-label">' + m.label + '</span>' +
        '<span class="metric-sub">' + m.sub + '</span></div>' +
        '<p class="metric-value">' + m.value + '</p>';
      var bottom = document.createElement("div");
      bottom.className = "metric-bottom";
      var delta = document.createElement("span");
      delta.className = "delta delta-" + tone;
      delta.innerHTML = arrow(m.direction) + m.change;
      var spark = document.createElement("span");
      spark.className = "spark-slot";
      spark.style.color = tone === "bad" ? "var(--crit)" : tone === "good" ? "var(--ok)" : "var(--text-2)";
      spark.appendChild(sparkline(series, 76, 22));
      bottom.appendChild(delta);
      bottom.appendChild(spark);
      li.appendChild(bottom);
      grid.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  function avg(arr) { return arr.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / arr.length; }

  function peakIndex(arr) {
    var idx = 0;
    for (var i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) { if (arr[i] > arr[idx]) { idx = i; } }
    return idx;
  }

  var chartGeom = { w: 0, h: 190, padL: 26, padR: 8, padT: 16, padB: 18, step: 0 };
  var chartBars = [];

  function renderChart() {
    var svgEl = $("chart");
    var wrap = svgEl.parentNode;
    var w = Math.max(280, wrap.clientWidth - 26);
    var h = window.innerWidth <= 720 ? 160 : 190;
    var data = SEED.throughput;
    var max = 100;
    var mean = avg(data);
    var peak = peakIndex(data);
    var padL = 26, padR = 8, padT = 16, padB = 18;
    var plotW = w - padL - padR;
    var plotH = h - padT - padB;
    var step = plotW / data.length;
    var barW = Math.max(4, Math.min(18, step - 3));

    svgEl.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + w + " " + h);
    svgEl.setAttribute("width", w);
    svgEl.setAttribute("height", h);
    while (svgEl.firstChild) { svgEl.removeChild(svgEl.firstChild); }
    chartBars = [];
    chartGeom = { w: w, h: h, padL: padL, padR: padR, padT: padT, padB: padB, step: step };

    var y = function (v) { return (padT + plotH - (v / max) * plotH).toFixed(1); };

    [0, 25, 50, 75, 100].forEach(function (v) {
      var yy = y(v);
      svgEl.appendChild(svg("line", { class: "grid-line", x1: padL, x2: w - padR, y1: yy, y2: yy }));
      var t = svg("text", { class: "axis-label", x: padL - 6, y: yy + 3, "text-anchor": "end" });
      t.textContent = v;
      svgEl.appendChild(t);
    });

    data.forEach(function (v, i) {
      var cx = padL + step * i + step / 2;
      var bh = Math.max(1.5, (v / max) * plotH);
      var cls = i === peak ? "bar bar-peak" : "bar";
      var rect = svg("rect", { class: cls, x: (cx - barW / 2).toFixed(1), y: (padT + plotH - bh).toFixed(1), width: barW.toFixed(1), height: bh.toFixed(1), rx: 1.5 });
      svgEl.appendChild(rect);
      chartBars.push({ i: i, v: v, cx: cx, top: padT + plotH - bh, bottom: padT + plotH, el: rect });
      if (i % 3 === 0) {
        var lb = svg("text", { class: "axis-label", x: cx.toFixed(1), y: h - 5, "text-anchor": "middle" });
        lb.textContent = (i < 10 ? "0" + i : i) + ":00";
        svgEl.appendChild(lb);
      }
    });

    var meanY = y(mean);
    svgEl.appendChild(svg("line", { class: "avg-line", x1: padL, x2: w - padR, y1: meanY, y2: meanY }));
    var ml = svg("text", { class: "avg-label", x: w - padR, y: (meanY - 5).toFixed(1), "text-anchor": "end" });
    ml.textContent = "mean " + mean.toFixed(0) + "k";
    svgEl.appendChild(ml);

    var pl = svg("text", { class: "peak-label", x: (padL + step * peak + step / 2).toFixed(1), y: (y(data[peak]) - 6).toFixed(1), "text-anchor": "middle" });
    pl.textContent = "peak " + data[peak] + "k";
    svgEl.appendChild(pl);

    var cursor = svg("line", { class: "chart-cursor", x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: padT - 4, y2: padT + plotH, opacity: 0 });
    svgEl.appendChild(cursor);
    chartGeom.cursor = cursor;

    $("throughputAvg").textContent = mean.toFixed(1);
    fillChartTable();
    if (state.chartIndex !== null) { paintChart(state.chartIndex); }
  }

  function fillChartTable() {
    var tb = $("chartTable").querySelector("tbody");
    tb.innerHTML = "";
    SEED.throughput.forEach(function (v, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      var th = document.createElement("th");
      th.scope = "row";
      th.textContent = (i < 10 ? "0" + i : i) + ":00";
      var td = document.createElement("td");
      td.textContent = v + "k";
      tr.appendChild(th);
      tr.appendChild(td);
      tb.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function paintChart(idx, spoken) {
    var g = chartGeom;
    if (!g.cursor) { return; }
    var b = chartBars[idx];
    if (!b) { return; }
    state.chartIndex = idx;
    g.cursor.setAttribute("x1", b.cx);
    g.cursor.setAttribute("x2", b.cx);
    g.cursor.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
    var peak = peakIndex(SEED.throughput);
    chartBars.forEach(function (other, i) {
      other.el.classList.toggle("bar-active", i === idx && i !== peak);
      other.el.classList.toggle("bar-peak", i === peak && i !== idx);
    });
    var hh = (idx < 10 ? "0" + idx : idx) + ":00";
    $("chartReadout").innerHTML = hh + " · <strong>" + b.v + "k</strong> events/min";
    var tip = $("chartTip");
    tip.hidden = false;
    tip.innerHTML = "<b>" + b.v + "k</b>" + hh + " – " + (idx === 23 ? "23:59" : (idx < 9 ? "0" + (idx + 1) : idx + 1) + ":00");
    var svgEl = $("chart");
    var wrap = svgEl.parentNode;
    var sr = svgEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    var wr = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scale = sr.width / g.w;
    var x = (sr.left - wr.left) + b.cx * scale;
    tip.style.left = Math.min(wrap.clientWidth - 58, Math.max(58, x)) + "px";
    tip.style.top = Math.max(54, b.top - 4) + "px";
    if (spoken) { announce(hh + " throughput " + b.v + " thousand events per minute"); }
  }

  function clearChart() {
    state.chartIndex = null;
    var g = chartGeom;
    if (g.cursor) { g.cursor.setAttribute("opacity", 0); }
    chartBars.forEach(function (b, i) {
      b.el.classList.remove("bar-active");
      b.el.classList.toggle("bar-peak", i === peakIndex(SEED.throughput));
    });
    $("chartReadout").textContent = "Hover or focus the chart, then use arrow keys";
    $("chartTip").hidden = true;
  }

  function bindChart() {
    var el = $("chart");
    var wrap = el.parentNode;

    function indexFromEvent(e) {
      var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      var x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (chartGeom.w / r.width);
      var i = Math.floor((x - chartGeom.padL) / chartGeom.step);
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(SEED.throughput.length - 1, i));
    }

    el.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) { paintChart(indexFromEvent(e), false); });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", clearChart);
    el.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) { paintChart(indexFromEvent(e.touches[0]), false); }, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener("touchmove", function (e) { paintChart(indexFromEvent(e.touches[0]), false); }, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener("focus", function () {
      if (state.chartIndex === null) { paintChart(peakIndex(SEED.throughput), true); }
    });
    el.addEventListener("blur", clearChart);
    el.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      var n = SEED.throughput.length;
      var i = state.chartIndex === null ? peakIndex(SEED.throughput) : state.chartIndex;
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { i = (i + 1) % n; }
      else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { i = (i - 1 + n) % n; }
      else if (e.key === "Home") { i = 0; }
      else if (e.key === "End") { i = n - 1; }
      else if (e.key === "Escape") { clearChart(); el.blur(); return; }
      else { return; }
      e.preventDefault();
      paintChart(i, true);
    });

    var t;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      window.clearTimeout(t);
      t = window.setTimeout(renderChart, 120);
    });
  }

  function filtered() {
    var q = state.query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return state.incidents.filter(function (i) {
      if (state.severity !== "all" && i.severity !== state.severity) { return false; }
      if (state.status !== "all" && i.status !== state.status) { return false; }
      if (!q) { return true; }
      return (i.id + " " + i.title + " " + i.service + " " + i.owner).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });
  }

  function sortRows(rows) {
    var k = state.sortKey;
    var dir = state.sortDir === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
    return rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var r;
      if (k === "severity") { r = SEV_ORDER[b.severity] - SEV_ORDER[a.severity]; }
      else if (k === "age") { r = b.minutes - a.minutes; }
      else if (k === "status") { r = STATUS_ORDER[b.status] - STATUS_ORDER[a.status]; }
      else if (k === "owner") { r = a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner); }
      else { r = a.id.localeCompare(b.id); }
      if (r === 0) { r = a.id.localeCompare(b.id); }
      return r * dir;
    });
  }

  function renderTable() {
    var rows = sortRows(filtered());
    var body = $("incidentBody");
    body.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function (inc) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.tabIndex = inc.id === state.selectedId ? 0 : -1;
      tr.dataset.id = inc.id;
      if (inc.id === state.selectedId) { tr.setAttribute("aria-current", "true"); }
      tr.innerHTML =
        '<td class="col-sev" data-label="Severity"><span class="sev sev-' + inc.severity + '"><i></i>' + inc.severity + "</span></td>" +
        '<td class="cell-id" data-label="Incident"><span class="id">' + inc.id + '</span><span class="title">' + inc.title + "</span></td>" +
        '<td class="col-service cell-mono" data-label="Service">' + inc.service + "</td>" +
        '<td class="col-age cell-age" data-label="Age">' + inc.age + "</td>" +
        '<td class="col-owner cell-owner' + (inc.owner === "Unassigned" ? " is-unassigned" : "") + '" data-label="Owner">' + inc.owner + "</td>" +
        '<td class="col-status" data-label="Status"><span class="status status-' + inc.status + '"><i></i>' + STATUS_LABEL[inc.status] + "</span></td>";
      tr.addEventListener("click", function () { select(inc.id, false); });
      tr.addEventListener("dblclick", function () { select(inc.id, true); });
      tr.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { return rowKeys(e, inc.id); });
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });

    var empty = rows.length === 0;
    $("emptyState").hidden = !empty;
    $("incidentTable").hidden = empty;
    if (empty) {
      var anyFilter = state.severity !== "all" || state.status !== "all" || state.query.trim() !== "";
      $("emptyDetail").textContent = anyFilter
        ? "No incident matches “" + (state.query.trim() || state.severity + " / " + state.status) + "”. Widen the filters to see the rest."
        : "No incidents are currently open.";
    }

    $("resultCount").textContent = rows.length + " of " + state.incidents.length + " shown";
    $("clearFilters").hidden = state.severity === "all" && state.status === "all" && state.query.trim() === "";
    $("railIncidentCount").textContent = state.incidents.length;
    renderRollup();
  }

  function renderRollup() {
    var c = { critical: 0, high: 0, other: 0 };
    state.incidents.forEach(function (i) {
      if (i.status === "acknowledged") { return; }
      if (i.severity === "critical") { c.critical++; }
      else if (i.severity === "high") { c.high++; }
      else { c.other++; }
    });
    var parts = [];
    if (c.critical) { parts.push(c.critical + " critical"); }
    if (c.high) { parts.push(c.high + " high"); }
    if (c.other) { parts.push(c.other + " tracked"); }
    $("statusRollup").textContent = parts.join(" · ") || "no active incidents";
  }

  function rowKeys(e, id) {
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call($("incidentBody").querySelectorAll("tr"));
    var idx = rows.findIndex(function (r) { return r.dataset.id === id; });
    var next = -1;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { next = Math.min(rows.length - 1, idx + 1); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { next = Math.max(0, idx - 1); }
    else if (e.key === "Home") { next = 0; }
    else if (e.key === "End") { next = rows.length - 1; }
    else if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); select(id, true); return; }
    else { return; }
    e.preventDefault();
    if (next >= 0 && rows[next]) {
      select(rows[next].dataset.id, false);
      rows[next].focus();
    }
  }

  function renderSevFilter() {
    var host = $("sevFilter");
    host.innerHTML = "";
    var opts = [{ v: "all", l: "All", s: "sev-flat" }].concat(
      ["critical", "high", "medium", "low"].map(function (s) {
        return { v: s, l: s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1), s: "sev-" + s };
      })
    );
    opts.forEach(function (o) {
      var count = o.v === "all" ? state.incidents.length : state.incidents.filter(function (i) { return i.severity === o.v; }).length;
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.className = "seg";
      b.dataset.value = o.v;
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(state.severity === o.v));
      b.innerHTML = '<span class="sev ' + o.s + '"><i></i></span>' + o.l + ' <span class="n">' + count + "</span>";
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        state.severity = o.v;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.children, function (c) {
          c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(c.dataset.value === state.severity));
        });
        renderTable();
      });
      host.appendChild(b);
    });
  }

  function renderServices() {
    var host = $("serviceGrid");
    host.innerHTML = "";
    SEED.services.forEach(function (s) {
      var color = s.burn >= 80 ? "var(--crit)" : s.burn >= 35 ? "var(--high)" : "var(--ok)";
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = "service";
      li.innerHTML =
        '<div class="service-top"><span class="service-name">' + s.name + '</span><span class="badge status status-' + (s.state === "breach" ? "open" : s.state === "warn" ? "monitoring" : "acknowledged") + '"><i></i>' + s.state + "</span></div>" +
        '<p class="service-value">' + s.burn + "%</p>" +
        '<div class="meter"><i style="width:' + s.burn + "%;background:" + color + '"></i></div>' +
        '<p class="service-sub">' + s.note + " · error budget burn</p>";
      host.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  function selected() {
    for (var i = 0; i < state.incidents.length; i++) {
      if (state.incidents[i].id === state.selectedId) { return state.incidents[i]; }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function renderDetail(announceSelection) {
    var inc = selected();
    var empty = $("detailEmpty");
    var content = $("detailContent");
    if (!inc) {
      empty.hidden = false;
      content.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    empty.hidden = true;
    content.hidden = false;

    var acked = inc.status === "acknowledged";
    var events = inc.events.slice();
    if (acked && inc.ackedAt) {
      events.unshift({ at: inc.ackedAt, who: OPERATOR, what: "Acknowledged — taking ownership of the response" });
    }
    content.innerHTML =
      '<div class="detail-head">' +
        '<div class="detail-kicker">' +
          '<span class="detail-id mono">' + inc.id + "</span>" +
          '<span class="sev sev-' + inc.severity + '"><i></i>' + inc.severity + "</span>" +
        "</div>" +
        "<h3>" + inc.title + "</h3>" +
        '<span class="status status-' + inc.status + '"><i></i>' + STATUS_LABEL[inc.status] + "</span>" +
      "</div>" +
      '<dl class="detail-meta">' +
        "<div><dt>Service</dt><dd class=\"mono\">" + inc.service + "</dd></div>" +
        "<div><dt>Age</dt><dd class=\"mono\">" + inc.age + "</dd></div>" +
        "<div><dt>Owner</dt><dd>" + inc.owner + "</dd></div>" +
        "<div><dt>Impact</dt><dd>" + inc.affected + "</dd></div>" +
      "</dl>" +
      '<div class="detail-section"><h4>Assessment</h4><p>' + inc.summary + "</p></div>" +
      '<div class="detail-section"><h4>Timeline</h4><ul class="timeline">' +
        events.map(function (e) {
          return "<li><time>" + e.at + "</time><b>" + e.who + "</b> — " + e.what + "</li>";
        }).join("") +
      "</ul></div>" +
      '<div class="detail-actions">' +
        '<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" id="ackBtn"' + (acked ? " disabled" : "") + ">Acknowledge</button>" +
        '<button class="btn" type="button" id="assignBtn"' + (inc.owner === OPERATOR ? " disabled" : "") + ">Assign to me</button>" +
        '<button class="btn btn-quiet btn-icon detail-close" type="button" id="detailClose" aria-label="Close detail panel">' +
          '<svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6.4 5 5.6 5.6L17.6 5 19 6.4 13.4 12 19 17.6 17.6 19 12 13.4 6.4 19 5 17.6 10.6 12 5 6.4 6.4 5Z"/></svg>' +
        "</button>" +
        '<p class="detail-ack-meta" id="ackMeta"' + (acked ? "" : " hidden") + ">" + (inc.ackedAt ? "Acknowledged " + inc.ackedAt : "") + " by " + (inc.ackedBy || OPERATOR) + "</p>" +
      "</div>";

    var ackBtn = $("ackBtn");
    if (ackBtn) {
      ackBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { acknowledge(inc.id); });
    }
    var assignBtn = $("assignBtn");
    if (assignBtn) {
      assignBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { assignToMe(inc.id); });
    }
    var closeBtn = $("detailClose");
    if (closeBtn) {
      closeBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        state.selectedId = null;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call($("incidentBody").querySelectorAll("tr"), function (r) {
          r.tabIndex = -1;
          r.removeAttribute("aria-current");
        });
        renderDetail(false);
        announce("Detail panel closed");
        var first = $("incidentBody").querySelector("tr");
        if (first) { first.tabIndex = 0; }
      });
    }
    if (announceSelection) {
      announce(inc.id + " selected: " + inc.title + ", " + inc.severity + ", " + inc.service + ", owner " + inc.owner + ", status " + STATUS_LABEL[inc.status]);
    }
  }

  function acknowledge(id) {
    var inc = null;
    state.incidents.forEach(function (i) { if (i.id === id) { inc = i; } });
    if (!inc || inc.status === "acknowledged") { return; }
    inc.status = "acknowledged";
    inc.owner = inc.owner === "Unassigned" ? OPERATOR : inc.owner;
    inc.ackedAt = nowLabel();
    inc.ackedBy = OPERATOR;
    inc.events.unshift({ at: inc.ackedAt, who: OPERATOR, what: "Acknowledged and claimed the incident" });
    renderTable();
    renderDetail(false);
    renderActivity();
    announce("Incident " + inc.id + " acknowledged by " + OPERATOR + ". Status set to acknowledged.");
    var focusTarget = document.querySelector('#incidentBody tr[data-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (focusTarget) { focusTarget.focus(); }
  }

  function assignToMe(id) {
    var inc = null;
    state.incidents.forEach(function (i) { if (i.id === id) { inc = i; } });
    if (!inc || inc.owner === OPERATOR) { return; }
    inc.owner = OPERATOR;
    inc.events.unshift({ at: nowLabel(), who: OPERATOR, what: "Assigned to " + OPERATOR });
    renderTable();
    renderDetail(false);
    renderActivity();
    announce(inc.id + " assigned to " + OPERATOR);
  }

  function select(id, focusPanel) {
    if (state.selectedId === id && !focusPanel) { return; }
    state.selectedId = id;
    var rows = $("incidentBody").querySelectorAll("tr");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(rows, function (r) {
      var on = r.dataset.id === id;
      r.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
      if (on) { r.setAttribute("aria-current", "true"); } else { r.removeAttribute("aria-current"); }
    });
    renderDetail(true);
    if (focusPanel) {
      var panel = $("detail");
      panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  function nowLabel() {
    var d = new Date();
    return String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + " UTC";
  }

  var liveTimer = null;
  function announce(msg) {
    var lr = $("liveRegion");
    window.clearTimeout(liveTimer);
    liveTimer = window.setTimeout(function () { lr.textContent = msg; }, 60);
  }

  function bindSort() {
    var ths = document.querySelectorAll("#incidentTable thead th[data-sort]");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(ths, function (th) {
      th.querySelector(".th-btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
        var key = th.dataset.sort;
        if (state.sortKey === key) {
          state.sortDir = state.sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
        } else {
          state.sortKey = key;
          state.sortDir = key === "severity" || key === "age" ? "desc" : "asc";
        }
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(ths, function (o) { o.removeAttribute("aria-sort"); });
        th.setAttribute("aria-sort", state.sortDir === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending");
        renderTable();
        announce("Sorted by " + key + ", " + (state.sortDir === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending"));
      });
    });
  }

  function bindFilters() {
    $("searchInput").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
      state.query = e.target.value;
      renderTable();
    });
    $("searchInput").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.target.value = "";
        state.query = "";
        renderTable();
      }
    });
    $("statusFilter").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
      state.status = e.target.value;
      renderTable();
    });
    var clear = function () {
      state.severity = "all";
      state.status = "all";
      state.query = "";
      $("searchInput").value = "";
      $("statusFilter").value = "all";
      renderSevFilter();
      renderTable();
      announce("Filters cleared");
    };
    $("clearFilters").addEventListener("click", clear);
    $("emptyClear").addEventListener("click", clear);
  }

  function bindShortcuts() {
    var dialog = $("shortcuts");
    var toggle = function (open) {
      dialog.hidden = open === false;
      if (!dialog.hidden) { $("shortcutsClose").focus(); }
    };
    $("shortcutsBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { toggle(!dialog.hidden); });
    $("shortcutsClose").addEventListener("click", function () { toggle(false); });

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      var t = e.target;
      var typing = t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "SELECT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA");
      if (e.key === "?") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(!dialog.hidden); return; }
      if (e.key === "Escape" && !dialog.hidden) { toggle(false); return; }
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || typing) { return; }
      if (e.key === "/") { e.preventDefault(); $("searchInput").focus(); return; }
      var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call($("incidentBody").querySelectorAll("tr"));
      if (!rows.length) { return; }
      var idx = rows.findIndex(function (r) { return r.dataset.id === state.selectedId; });
      var target = -1;
      if (e.key === "j") { target = Math.min(rows.length - 1, (idx < 0 ? -1 : idx) + 1); }
      else if (e.key === "k") { target = Math.max(0, (idx < 0 ? 0 : idx) - 1); }
      else if (e.key === "a" && idx >= 0) {
        e.preventDefault();
        acknowledge(rows[idx].dataset.id);
        return;
      } else { return; }
      e.preventDefault();
      select(rows[target].dataset.id, false);
      rows[target].focus();
    });
  }

  function renderActivity() {
    var host = $("feed");
    var items = [];
    state.incidents.forEach(function (inc) {
      inc.events.forEach(function (e) {
        items.push({ inc: inc, at: e.at, who: e.what && e.who, what: e.what, minutes: inc.minutes });
      });
    });
    items.sort(function (a, b) { return a.minutes - b.minutes; });
    host.innerHTML = "";
    items.slice(0, 9).forEach(function (it) {
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = "feed-item";
      li.innerHTML =
        '<span class="sev sev-' + it.inc.severity + '"><i></i></span>' +
        '<span class="feed-time mono">' + it.at + "</span>" +
        '<span class="feed-body"><b>' + it.inc.id + "</b> " + it.what + ' <span class="feed-who">— ' + it.who + "</span></span>";
      li.addEventListener("click", function () { select(it.inc.id, false); document.getElementById("incidents").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" }); });
      host.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  function bindScrollSpy() {
    var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".rail-link"));
    var map = {};
    links.forEach(function (l) {
      var id = l.getAttribute("href").slice(1);
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) { map[id] = l; }
    });
    if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) { return; }
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (!en.isIntersecting) { return; }
        links.forEach(function (l) { l.classList.remove("is-active"); l.removeAttribute("aria-current"); });
        var link = map[en.target.id];
        if (link) { link.classList.add("is-active"); link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page"); }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "-20% 0px -70% 0px", threshold: 0 });
    Object.keys(map).forEach(function (id) { io.observe(document.getElementById(id)); });
  }

  function tick() {
    var d = new Date();
    var p = function (n) { return String(n).padStart(2, "0"); };
    $("clock").textContent = p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCSeconds()) + " UTC";
    $("footerStamp").textContent = "seeded " + p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + "Z · " + state.incidents.length + " incidents · eu-west-1";
  }

  renderMetrics();
  renderChart();
  bindChart();
  renderSevFilter();
  renderTable();
  renderDetail(true);
  renderServices();
  renderActivity();
  bindSort();
  bindFilters();
  bindShortcuts();
  bindScrollSpy();
  tick();
  window.setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
