hy4-preview-codebuddy/11-frontend-operations/RESPONSE.md

Relay — operations control room

Built with local HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS only. No frameworks, installs, fonts, remote assets, or network calls. Files: index.html, styles.css, app.js, plus this note. Content is seeded from DATA.json.

Visual hierarchy

Three tiers, so an operator can answer "is anything wrong, what is it, what do I do" in that order:

  1. Status (top bar + rail). The rail is the constant frame (product mark, five destinations, current on-call). The top bar carries the single global verdict — a status pill that recomputes from incident state (Degraded · 1 critical → Attention · 1 high → All clear · 2 active) — plus UTC clock, search, and range.
  2. Scanning (metrics + throughput). Four metrics at equal weight: label, big tabular number, delta chip, sparkline, and a vs previous 24 h baseline. Below, the 24-hour throughput chart occupies full width because it is the only element that needs horizontal room to be legible.
  3. Acting (incidents + detail). The incident table is the largest surface and sits beside a persistent detail panel, so triage never loses context.

Palette: neutral slate foundation (#0b0e13 → #1b232e), one accent (teal #2dd4bf) reserved for selection, primary action, and the peak bar. Severity and status use a small functional set (red / amber / yellow / slate, plus green and blue status dots) and are always paired with a text label, never colour alone. Every number uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and a mono stack so columns align and ages don't jitter as they tick. Spacing is 4/8/12 px, radius is 4–6 px, and there is no glass, gradient, or oversized type.

Chart: inline SVG (semantic-ish, scales with its container) with gridlines, y ticks, hourly bars, a dashed mean line, the peak bar picked out in accent, a hover tooltip, and an aria-label summary. The viewBox is re-rendered to the container's pixel width on resize so labels stay crisp instead of stretching.

Interaction behaviour

  • Filters — search (id, title, service, owner, severity, status), severity, service, status, and an "Unassigned only" toggle. They compose; results and the count line update live, and Clear (or the button inside the empty state) resets everything.
  • Sorting — severity and age headers. First click shows the most actionable order (worst severity first, oldest first); clicking again reverses.
  • Selection — clicking a row (or Enter/Space on a focused row) loads the detail panel: metadata, three impact signals with proportional bars, a newest-first timeline, and the actions. Selection is dropped if filters hide the row, which puts the panel into its own empty state rather than showing stale data.
  • Acknowledge — the working action. It sets status to acknowledged, claims the incident if the owner is Unassigned, prepends a timeline entry, updates the row badge, the status pill, and the rail count, and confirms via toast. It is reachable three ways: the row Ack button, the primary button in the panel, or the A key. Once acknowledged the control becomes a disabled Acknowledged button — idempotent, no dead click. Assign to me is a separate, smaller ownership action so acknowledging doesn't silently imply ownership.
  • Ages tick every minute (seeded age + elapsed wall clock) and the clock updates every 20 s, so the room feels live without noisy animation.

Keyboard

/ focuses search from anywhere. Inside the grid: ↑/↓ or j/k move, Home/End jump, Enter opens, A acknowledges. Focus follows re-renders — after acknowledging, the focused row (or the detail panel, if that's where the action was invoked) keeps focus instead of dropping to the body.

Accessibility

  • Landmarks (nav, header, main, aside), one h1, and a skip link.
  • The table is a role="grid" with aria-selected rows and a single tabbable row (roving tabindex), so arrow keys work as expected and Tab doesn't walk 4 rows.
  • Sortable headers expose aria-sort; the chip exposes aria-pressed; icon-only controls have sr-only labels; decorative icons are aria-hidden.
  • Two polite live regions: the result count and the toast status region. Changes caused by an action are announced without hijacking focus.
  • Delta chips spell out "increased/decreased" for screen readers; the chart carries a text alternative with mean, peak hour, and low.
  • Visible :focus-visible ring on every interactive element, including rows and the chart tooltip trigger states; prefers-reduced-motion disables animation.

Responsive

≤980 px the detail panel stacks under the table and metrics go 2-up. ≤860 px the rail becomes an icon-only horizontal bar and the top bar wraps. ≤700 px the table is rebuilt as stacked cards (labels via data-label pseudo-elements) with the ack button per card. Verified at 390 px: scrollWidth === clientWidth, no element extends past the viewport, chart re-renders to ~330 px, and nothing needs horizontal page scrolling.

Data

app.js fetches DATA.json when served over http(s) and falls back to an identical embedded seed when opened directly from disk (file://), which blocks fetch. The seed is kept byte-identical in content to DATA.json. Timeline entries and impact signals are derived deterministically from the incident id, service, and status, so the panel is never empty and never invents contradictions (e.g. an unassigned incident shows a routing-not-claimed entry).

Verification

Headless-Chrome smoke pass: 4 metric cards with sparklines, 24 bars with one peak, sorting and all five filters, the empty state, acknowledge from row / panel / keyboard, assign-to-me, focus restoration, tooltip, / shortcut, and a 390 px layout check with zero horizontal overflow.

hy4-preview-codebuddy/11-frontend-operations/TASK.md

Task 11 — Frontend design: operations control room

Build a polished, responsive single-page operations dashboard called Relay using only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, package installs, external fonts, remote assets, or network requests.

Visual direction: calm, high-density control-room software for expert operators. Use a restrained neutral palette with one purposeful accent, excellent numeric alignment, compact spacing, and clear severity states. Avoid glassmorphism, decorative gradients, giant headings, and excessive rounded cards.

The page must include:

  • A navigation rail and top status bar.
  • Four summary metrics with trend context.
  • A 24-hour throughput visualization made with semantic HTML, CSS, canvas, or inline SVG.
  • A filterable incident table with severity, service, age, owner, and status.
  • A detail panel for the selected incident and a working acknowledge action.
  • Useful empty/filter states and visible keyboard focus.
  • A mobile layout that remains usable at 390 px without horizontal page scroll.

Seed realistic content from DATA.json. Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the hierarchy, interaction behavior, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

hy4-preview-codebuddy/11-frontend-operations/app.js

/* ============================================================
   Relay — operations control room
   Vanilla JS. No dependencies, no network required.
   Data comes from DATA.json when served over http(s); when the
   page is opened straight from disk (file://) the same seed is
   used so the dashboard always renders.
   ============================================================ */

(function () {
  'use strict';

  var CURRENT_USER = 'A. Novak';

  /* Fallback seed — mirrors DATA.json exactly. */
  var SEED = {
    metrics: [
      { label: 'Events / min', value: '18,420', change: '+8.2%', direction: 'up' },
      { label: 'P95 latency', value: '184 ms', change: '−12 ms', direction: 'down' },
      { label: 'Error rate', value: '0.37%', change: '+0.08 pp', direction: 'up' },
      { label: 'Queue depth', value: '2,841', change: '−19%', direction: 'down' }
    ],
    throughput: [31, 28, 24, 22, 20, 23, 34, 48, 62, 71, 76, 73, 68, 72, 80, 84, 79, 75, 82, 88, 77, 63, 52, 41],
    incidents: [
      { id: 'INC-2841', severity: 'critical', service: 'payments-api', age: '12m', owner: 'M. Chen', status: 'investigating', title: 'Card authorization timeouts' },
      { id: 'INC-2839', severity: 'high', service: 'event-router', age: '31m', owner: 'Unassigned', status: 'open', title: 'EU retry queue growth' },
      { id: 'INC-2837', severity: 'medium', service: 'search-index', age: '1h 08m', owner: 'A. Silva', status: 'monitoring', title: 'Index freshness outside SLO' },
      { id: 'INC-2832', severity: 'low', service: 'webhooks', age: '3h 42m', owner: 'R. Patel', status: 'open', title: 'Elevated partner delivery lag' }
    ]
  };

  var SEVERITY_RANK = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2, low: 3 };
  var STATUS_ORDER = { open: 0, investigating: 1, monitoring: 2, acknowledged: 3 };

  var state = {
    incidents: [],
    metrics: [],
    throughput: [],
    search: '',
    severity: 'all',
    service: 'all',
    status: 'all',
    unassignedOnly: false,
    sort: { key: 'severity', dir: 'desc' },
    selectedId: null,
    focusId: null,
    startedAt: Date.now()
  };

  var el = {};
  var lastChartWidth = 0;

  /* ---------- helpers ---------- */

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function esc(v) {
    return String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }

  function byId(id) {
    for (var i = 0; i < state.incidents.length; i++) {
      if (state.incidents[i].id === id) return state.incidents[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* "1h 08m" -> 68 ; "12m" -> 12 */
  function parseAge(str) {
    var m = /(?:(\d+)\s*h)?\s*(?:(\d+)\s*m)?/.exec(String(str));
    var h = parseInt(m && m[1], 10) || 0;
    var mm = parseInt(m && m[2], 10) || 0;
    return h * 60 + mm;
  }

  function fmtAge(totalMin) {
    var v = Math.max(0, Math.round(totalMin));
    var h = Math.floor(v / 60);
    var m = v % 60;
    if (h === 0) return m + 'm';
    return h + 'h ' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + 'm';
  }

  /* Live age = seeded age + wall-clock minutes since load. */
  function liveAge(inc) {
    var extra = Math.floor((Date.now() - state.startedAt) / 60000);
    return inc.baseAge + extra;
  }

  function hashNum(str) {
    var n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) n = (n * 31 + str.charCodeAt(i)) % 100000;
    return n;
  }

  function sparkPoints(seed, direction) {
    var pts = [];
    var v = 12;
    var drift = direction === 'up' ? 0.5 : -0.5;
    for (var i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      v += Math.sin(seed * 0.017 + i * 0.7) * 1.9 + drift;
      pts.push(Math.max(3, Math.min(23, v)));
    }
    return pts;
  }

  /* ---------- data ---------- */

  function loadData(cb) {
    if (location.protocol === 'file:') { cb(SEED); return; }
    fetch('DATA.json')
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('bad response'); return r.json(); })
      .then(cb)
      .catch(function () { cb(SEED); });
  }

  function init(data) {
    state.metrics = data.metrics || [];
    state.throughput = data.throughput || [];
    state.incidents = (data.incidents || []).map(function (inc) {
      return {
        id: inc.id,
        severity: inc.severity,
        service: inc.service,
        title: inc.title,
        owner: inc.owner,
        status: inc.status,
        baseAge: parseAge(inc.age),
        timeline: buildTimeline(inc)
      };
    });

    state.selectedId = defaultSelection();
    state.focusId = state.selectedId;

    cacheEls();
    renderMetricCards();
    renderLegend();
    renderChart();
    populateServices();
    bindEvents();
    renderTable();
    renderDetail();
    renderStatusBars();
    startClock();
  }

  function defaultSelection() {
    var active = state.incidents.filter(function (i) { return i.status !== 'acknowledged'; });
    active.sort(function (a, b) { return SEVERITY_RANK[a.severity] - SEVERITY_RANK[b.severity]; });
    return active.length ? active[0].id : (state.incidents[0] ? state.incidents[0].id : null);
  }

  function cacheEls() {
    el.metrics = $('metrics');
    el.legend = $('chart-legend');
    el.chartWrap = $('chart-wrap');
    el.chart = $('chart');
    el.tip = $('chart-tip');
    el.body = $('incident-body');
    el.tableEmpty = $('table-empty');
    el.table = $('incident-table');
    el.detail = $('detail-body');
    el.resultCount = $('result-count');
    el.toasts = $('toast-region');
    el.pill = $('system-pill');
    el.pillText = $('system-pill-text');
    el.railCount = $('rail-open-count');
    el.clock = $('clock');
  }

  /* ---------- metrics ---------- */

  function sentimentFor(metric) {
    var label = metric.label.toLowerCase();
    var lowerIsBetter = /latency|error|queue|depth|backlog/.test(label);
    if (metric.direction === 'down') return lowerIsBetter ? 'good' : 'bad';
    if (metric.direction === 'up') return lowerIsBetter ? 'bad' : 'good';
    return 'flat';
  }

  function renderMetricCards() {
    el.metrics.innerHTML = state.metrics.map(function (m, i) {
      var sentiment = sentimentFor(m);
      var seed = hashNum(m.label + i);
      var pts = sparkPoints(seed, m.direction);
      var w = 78, h = 26;
      var max = 26;
      var coords = pts.map(function (p, idx) {
        var x = (idx / (pts.length - 1)) * w;
        var y = h - (p / max) * h;
        return x.toFixed(1) + ',' + y.toFixed(1);
      }).join(' ');
      var stroke = sentiment === 'good' ? 'var(--ok)' : sentiment === 'bad' ? 'var(--sev-high)' : 'var(--accent)';
      var arrow = m.direction === 'up' ? '▲' : m.direction === 'down' ? '▼' : '■';
      var word = m.direction === 'up' ? 'increased' : m.direction === 'down' ? 'decreased' : 'unchanged';

      return '' +
        '<article class="metric">' +
          '<p class="metric__label">' + esc(m.label) + '</p>' +
          '<div class="metric__row">' +
            '<span class="metric__value">' + esc(m.value) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="metric__delta metric__delta--' + sentiment + '">' +
              '<span aria-hidden="true">' + arrow + '</span>' +
              '<span class="sr-only">' + word + ' </span>' +
              esc(m.change) +
            '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="metric__foot">' +
            '<span class="metric__context">vs previous 24 h</span>' +
            '<svg class="metric__spark" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + w + ' ' + h + '" aria-hidden="true">' +
              '<polyline points="' + coords + '" fill="none" style="stroke:' + stroke + '" stroke-width="1.4" ' +
              'stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.9"/>' +
            '</svg>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</article>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ---------- chart ---------- */

  function renderLegend() {
    var vals = state.throughput;
    if (!vals.length) { el.legend.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var peak = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
    var peakIdx = vals.indexOf(peak);
    var mean = vals.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / vals.length;
    el.legend.innerHTML =
      '<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch legend-swatch--peak" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
        'Peak <span class="legend-value">' + peak + '</span> at ' + hourLabel(peakIdx) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch legend-swatch--avg" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
        'Mean <span class="legend-value">' + mean.toFixed(1) + '</span></span>';
  }

  function hourLabel(i) { return String(i).padStart(2, '0') + ':00'; }

  function renderChart() {
    var vals = state.throughput;
    var host = el.chart;
    if (!vals.length) { host.innerHTML = ''; return; }

    var w = Math.max(280, Math.floor(host.clientWidth || 640));
    var h = w < 560 ? 176 : 224;
    var padL = 30, padR = 8, padT = 16, padB = 24;
    var plotW = w - padL - padR;
    var plotH = h - padT - padB;
    var baseline = padT + plotH;

    var peak = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
    var peakIdx = vals.indexOf(peak);
    var mean = vals.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / vals.length;
    var scaleMax = Math.max(20, Math.ceil(peak / 20) * 20);

    var yOf = function (v) { return baseline - (v / scaleMax) * plotH; };
    var slot = plotW / vals.length;
    var barW = Math.min(20, Math.max(4, slot * 0.6));

    var svg = [];
    svg.push('<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + w + ' ' + h + '" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '" role="img" ' +
             'aria-label="Hourly throughput index over the last 24 hours. Mean ' + mean.toFixed(1) +
             ', peak ' + peak + ' at ' + hourLabel(peakIdx) + ', low ' + Math.min.apply(null, vals) + '.">');

    /* grid + y ticks */
    for (var t = 0; t <= 4; t++) {
      var frac = t / 4;
      var y = baseline - frac * plotH;
      svg.push('<line class="chart__grid-line" x1="' + padL + '" y1="' + y.toFixed(1) + '" x2="' + (w - padR) + '" y2="' + y.toFixed(1) + '"/>');
      svg.push('<text class="chart__tick" x="' + (padL - 7) + '" y="' + (y + 3).toFixed(1) + '" text-anchor="end">' + Math.round(scaleMax * frac) + '</text>');
    }
    svg.push('<line class="chart__axis" x1="' + padL + '" y1="' + baseline + '" x2="' + (w - padR) + '" y2="' + baseline + '"/>');

    /* bars */
    for (var i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      var bx = padL + i * slot + (slot - barW) / 2;
      var by = yOf(vals[i]);
      var bh = Math.max(1, baseline - by);
      var isPeak = i === peakIdx;
      svg.push('<g class="chart__group" data-i="' + i + '" data-x="' + (bx + barW / 2).toFixed(1) + '" data-y="' + by.toFixed(1) + '">');
      svg.push('<rect class="chart__hit" x="' + (padL + i * slot).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + padT + '" width="' + slot.toFixed(1) + '" height="' + plotH + '"/>');
      svg.push('<rect class="chart__bar' + (isPeak ? ' chart__bar--peak' : '') + '" x="' + bx.toFixed(1) + '" y="' + by.toFixed(1) +
               '" width="' + barW.toFixed(1) + '" height="' + bh.toFixed(1) + '" rx="1.5"/>');
      svg.push('</g>');
    }

    /* mean line */
    var meanY = yOf(mean);
    svg.push('<line class="chart__avg" x1="' + padL + '" y1="' + meanY.toFixed(1) + '" x2="' + (w - padR) + '" y2="' + meanY.toFixed(1) + '"/>');
    svg.push('<text class="chart__avg-label" x="' + (w - padR) + '" y="' + (meanY - 5).toFixed(1) + '" text-anchor="end">mean ' + mean.toFixed(1) + '</text>');

    /* x labels every 3 hours */
    for (var k = 0; k < vals.length; k += 3) {
      svg.push('<text class="chart__tick" x="' + (padL + k * slot + slot / 2).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (baseline + 14) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + String(k).padStart(2, '0') + '</text>');
    }

    svg.push('</svg>');
    host.innerHTML = svg.join('');

    lastChartWidth = w;

    var groups = host.querySelectorAll('.chart__group');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(groups, function (g) {
      g.addEventListener('mouseenter', showTip);
      g.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip);
    });
  }

  function showTip(e) {
    var g = e.currentTarget;
    var i = parseInt(g.getAttribute('data-i'), 10);
    var x = parseFloat(g.getAttribute('data-x'));
    var y = parseFloat(g.getAttribute('data-y'));
    g.classList.add('is-active');
    el.tip.innerHTML = hourLabel(i) + ' · index <b>' + state.throughput[i] + '</b>';
    el.tip.hidden = false;
    el.tip.style.left = (el.chart.offsetLeft + x) + 'px';
    el.tip.style.top = (el.chart.offsetTop + y - 8) + 'px';
  }

  function hideTip(e) {
    e.currentTarget.classList.remove('is-active');
    el.tip.hidden = true;
  }

  /* ---------- filtering + sorting ---------- */

  function visibleIncidents() {
    var q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    var list = state.incidents.filter(function (inc) {
      if (state.severity !== 'all' && inc.severity !== state.severity) return false;
      if (state.status !== 'all' && inc.status !== state.status) return false;
      if (state.service !== 'all' && inc.service !== state.service) return false;
      if (state.unassignedOnly && inc.owner !== 'Unassigned') return false;
      if (q) {
        var hay = (inc.id + ' ' + inc.title + ' ' + inc.service + ' ' + inc.owner + ' ' + inc.severity + ' ' + inc.status).toLowerCase();
        if (hay.indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    /* "desc" always means "most significant first": worst severity / oldest age. */
    var key = state.sort.key;
    var desc = state.sort.dir === 'desc';
    list.sort(function (a, b) {
      var r;
      if (key === 'age') {
        r = liveAge(a) - liveAge(b);
      } else {
        r = SEVERITY_RANK[a.severity] - SEVERITY_RANK[b.severity];
        if (r === 0) r = STATUS_ORDER[a.status] - STATUS_ORDER[b.status];
      }
      if (r === 0) r = a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1;
      /* age: desc = oldest first (reverse of raw minutes).
         severity: desc = critical first (rank 0 ascending). */
      if (key === 'age') return desc ? -r : r;
      return desc ? r : -r;
    });
    return list;
  }

  function filtersActive() {
    return state.severity !== 'all' || state.status !== 'all' || state.service !== 'all' ||
           state.unassignedOnly || state.search.trim() !== '';
  }

  /* ---------- table ---------- */

  function renderTable() {
    var list = visibleIncidents();
    var total = state.incidents.length;

    el.resultCount.textContent = filtersActive()
      ? 'Showing ' + list.length + ' of ' + total + ' incidents'
      : list.length + ' incidents · ' + activeCount() + ' active';

    /* Keep exactly one row tabbable so the grid stays reachable after filtering. */
    if (!state.focusId || !list.some(function (i) { return i.id === state.focusId; })) {
      state.focusId = list.length ? list[0].id : null;
    }
    if (state.selectedId && !list.some(function (i) { return i.id === state.selectedId; })) {
      state.selectedId = null;
    }

    el.tableEmpty.hidden = list.length !== 0;
    el.table.hidden = list.length === 0;

    el.body.innerHTML = list.map(function (inc) {
      var selected = inc.id === state.selectedId;
      var acked = inc.status === 'acknowledged';
      var tabIndex = inc.id === state.focusId ? '0' : '-1';
      return '' +
        '<tr class="' + (selected ? 'is-selected ' : '') + (acked ? 'is-acked' : '') + '"' +
            ' data-id="' + esc(inc.id) + '" tabindex="' + tabIndex + '"' +
            ' role="row" aria-selected="' + (selected ? 'true' : 'false') + '">' +
          '<td class="col-sev" data-label="Severity">' + sevMarkup(inc.severity) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="col-id cell-id" data-label="ID">' + esc(inc.id) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="cell-main" data-label="Incident">' +
            '<div class="cell-title">' + esc(inc.title) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="cell-service">' + esc(inc.service) + '</div>' +
          '</td>' +
          '<td class="col-age cell-age" data-label="Age">' + fmtAge(liveAge(inc)) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="col-owner" data-label="Owner">' +
            '<span class="cell-owner' + (inc.owner === 'Unassigned' ? ' is-unassigned' : '') + '">' + esc(inc.owner) + '</span>' +
          '</td>' +
          '<td class="col-status" data-label="Status">' + statusMarkup(inc.status) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="col-act" data-label="Action">' + ackButton(inc) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    var ths = el.table.querySelectorAll('th');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(ths, function (th) {
      var btn = th.querySelector('.th-sort');
      if (!btn) return;
      if (btn.getAttribute('data-sort') === state.sort.key) {
        th.setAttribute('aria-sort', state.sort.dir === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending');
      } else {
        th.removeAttribute('aria-sort');
      }
    });
  }

  function sevMarkup(sev) {
    return '<span class="sev sev--' + sev + '"><span class="sev__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>' + esc(sev) + '</span>';
  }

  function statusMarkup(status) {
    return '<span class="status status--' + status + '"><span class="status__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>' + esc(status) + '</span>';
  }

  function ackButton(inc) {
    if (inc.status === 'acknowledged') {
      return '<button class="btn row-ack" type="button" data-ack="' + esc(inc.id) + '" disabled>Acknowledged</button>';
    }
    return '<button class="btn row-ack" type="button" data-ack="' + esc(inc.id) + '">Ack</button>';
  }

  function activeCount() {
    return state.incidents.filter(function (i) { return i.status !== 'acknowledged'; }).length;
  }

  /* ---------- detail ---------- */

  function buildTimeline(inc) {
    var age = parseAge(inc.age);
    var items = [];
    items.push({ m: age, text: 'Alert fired — ' + inc.title, key: true });
    if (inc.owner === 'Unassigned') {
      items.push({ m: Math.max(0, age - 3), text: 'Auto-routed to on-call queue · no owner claimed' });
    } else {
      items.push({ m: Math.max(0, age - 3), text: 'Routed to ' + inc.owner });
    }
    if (inc.status === 'investigating') {
      items.push({ m: Math.max(0, age - 6), text: 'Investigation started · runbook RB-14 attached' });
    } else if (inc.status === 'monitoring') {
      items.push({ m: Math.max(0, age - 9), text: 'Mitigation applied · watching for regression' });
    } else if (inc.status === 'open') {
      items.push({ m: Math.max(0, age - 8), text: 'Triage pending · awaiting first response' });
    }
    items.push({ m: Math.max(0, age - Math.min(20, Math.floor(age / 2))), text: 'Correlated signals attached from ' + inc.service });
    return items;
  }

  function signalsFor(inc) {
    var n = parseInt(String(inc.id).replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 1000;
    var boost = { critical: 180, high: 95, medium: 40, low: 12 }[inc.severity] || 20;
    var p95 = 148 + boost + (n % 47);
    var err = ((n % 23) / 10 + (boost / 120)).toFixed(2);
    var affected = 1200 + (n % 41) * 68;
    return [
      { name: 'p95 latency', value: p95 + ' ms', level: p95 > 300 ? 'is-bad' : p95 > 220 ? 'is-warn' : '', pct: Math.min(100, p95 / 5) },
      { name: 'Error rate', value: err + '%', level: parseFloat(err) > 1.5 ? 'is-bad' : parseFloat(err) > 0.5 ? 'is-warn' : '', pct: Math.min(100, parseFloat(err) * 40) },
      { name: 'Affected requests', value: affected.toLocaleString('en-US'), level: '', pct: Math.min(100, affected / 60) }
    ];
  }

  function renderDetail() {
    var inc = byId(state.selectedId);
    if (!inc) {
      el.detail.innerHTML =
        '<div class="empty">' +
          '<p class="empty__title">No incident selected</p>' +
          '<p class="empty__body">Pick a row from the incident table to inspect signals, timeline, ' +
          'and ownership. Keyboard: ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to open.</p>' +
        '</div>';
      return;
    }

    var acked = inc.status === 'acknowledged';
    var signals = signalsFor(inc);

    var html = '' +
      '<div class="detail__head">' +
        '<div>' +
          '<p class="detail__id">' + esc(inc.id) + '</p>' +
          '<h3 class="detail__title">' + esc(inc.title) + '</h3>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="detail__badges">' +
          '<span class="badge badge--' + inc.severity + '"><span class="badge__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>' + esc(inc.severity) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="status status--' + inc.status + '">' +
            '<span class="status__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>' + esc(inc.status) + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<div class="detail__section">' +
        '<p class="detail__label">Details</p>' +
        '<dl class="kv">' +
          '<dt>Service</dt><dd class="is-text">' + esc(inc.service) + '</dd>' +
          '<dt>Owner</dt><dd class="is-text">' + esc(inc.owner) + '</dd>' +
          '<dt>Age</dt><dd>' + fmtAge(liveAge(inc)) + '</dd>' +
          '<dt>Region</dt><dd class="is-text">us-east-1</dd>' +
        '</dl>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<div class="detail__section">' +
        '<p class="detail__label">Signals</p>' +
        '<div class="signals">' +
          signals.map(function (s) {
            return '<div class="signal">' +
                '<span class="signal__name">' + esc(s.name) + '</span>' +
                '<span class="signal__value ' + s.level + '">' + esc(s.value) + '</span>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="signal__bar" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:' + s.pct.toFixed(0) + '%"></span></div>';
          }).join('') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<div class="detail__section">' +
        '<p class="detail__label">Timeline</p>' +
        '<ol class="timeline">' +
          inc.timeline.map(function (t) {
            return '<li class="timeline__item' + (t.key ? ' is-key' : '') + '">' +
              '<p class="timeline__time">T−' + fmtAge(t.m) + '</p>' +
              '<p class="timeline__text">' + esc(t.text) + '</p>' +
            '</li>';
          }).join('') +
        '</ol>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<div class="detail__actions">' +
        '<div class="detail__actions-row">' +
          '<button class="btn btn--primary btn--block" type="button" data-ack="' + esc(inc.id) + '"' +
            (acked ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (acked ? 'Acknowledged' : 'Acknowledge') + '</button>' +
          '<button class="btn btn--block" type="button" data-assign="' + esc(inc.id) + '"' +
            (inc.owner === CURRENT_USER ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' +
            (inc.owner === CURRENT_USER ? 'Assigned to you' : 'Assign to me') + '</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<p class="detail__note">' +
          (acked ? 'Acknowledged by ' + esc(inc.owner) + ' · page silenced'
                 : 'Acknowledging pages ' + esc(inc.owner === 'Unassigned' ? CURRENT_USER : inc.owner) + ' and starts the SLA clock') +
        '</p>' +
      '</div>';

    el.detail.innerHTML = html;
  }

  /* ---------- actions ---------- */

  function acknowledge(id, fromDetail) {
    var inc = byId(id);
    if (!inc || inc.status === 'acknowledged') return;
    var claimed = inc.owner === 'Unassigned';
    inc.status = 'acknowledged';
    if (claimed) inc.owner = CURRENT_USER;
    inc.timeline.unshift({ m: 0, text: 'Acknowledged by ' + CURRENT_USER + (claimed ? ' · ownership claimed' : ''), key: true });
    toast('<b>' + esc(inc.id) + '</b> acknowledged' + (claimed ? ' · assigned to ' + CURRENT_USER : ''));
    state.focusId = id;
    renderTable();
    renderDetail();
    renderStatusBars();
    restoreFocus(id, fromDetail);
  }

  function assignToMe(id, fromDetail) {
    var inc = byId(id);
    if (!inc || inc.owner === CURRENT_USER) return;
    inc.owner = CURRENT_USER;
    inc.timeline.unshift({ m: 0, text: 'Ownership claimed by ' + CURRENT_USER });
    toast('<b>' + esc(inc.id) + '</b> assigned to ' + CURRENT_USER);
    state.focusId = id;
    renderTable();
    renderDetail();
    restoreFocus(id, fromDetail);
  }

  /* Re-rendering replaces the row/button, so put focus back where the operator was. */
  function restoreFocus(id, fromDetail) {
    if (fromDetail) {
      var panel = $('detail');
      if (panel) panel.focus();
      return;
    }
    var row = el.body.querySelector('tr[data-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (row) row.focus();
  }

  function selectIncident(id) {
    state.selectedId = id;
    state.focusId = id;
    renderTable();
    renderDetail();
    var row = el.body.querySelector('tr[data-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (row) row.focus();
  }

  function toast(html) {
    var node = document.createElement('div');
    node.className = 'toast';
    node.innerHTML = html;
    el.toasts.appendChild(node);
    setTimeout(function () {
      node.style.transition = 'opacity 160ms linear';
      node.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(function () { if (node.parentNode) node.parentNode.removeChild(node); }, 180);
    }, 3200);
  }

  function renderStatusBars() {
    var crit = state.incidents.filter(function (i) { return i.severity === 'critical' && i.status !== 'acknowledged'; }).length;
    var high = state.incidents.filter(function (i) { return i.severity === 'high' && i.status !== 'acknowledged'; }).length;
    var active = activeCount();

    el.pill.className = 'status-pill ' + (crit ? 'is-degraded' : high ? 'is-attention' : 'is-clear');
    el.pillText.textContent = crit
      ? 'Degraded · ' + crit + ' critical'
      : high ? 'Attention · ' + high + ' high'
      : 'All clear · ' + active + ' active';
    el.railCount.textContent = String(active);
  }

  function startClock() {
    function tick() {
      var d = new Date();
      el.clock.textContent = String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' +
        String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') + ' UTC';
    }
    tick();
    setInterval(tick, 20000);
    /* ages advance every minute */
    setInterval(function () {
      renderTable();
      renderDetail();
    }, 60000);
  }

  /* ---------- events ---------- */

  function populateServices() {
    var sel = $('f-service');
    var seen = {};
    state.incidents.forEach(function (i) { seen[i.service] = true; });
    Object.keys(seen).sort().forEach(function (s) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = s;
      opt.textContent = s;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function bindEvents() {
    var searchTimer = null;
    $('search').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      var v = e.target.value;
      clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      searchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        state.search = v;
        renderTable();
        renderDetail();
      }, 120);
    });

    $('f-severity').addEventListener('change', function (e) { state.severity = e.target.value; renderTable(); renderDetail(); });
    $('f-status').addEventListener('change', function (e) { state.status = e.target.value; renderTable(); renderDetail(); });
    $('f-service').addEventListener('change', function (e) { state.service = e.target.value; renderTable(); renderDetail(); });

    $('f-unassigned').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      state.unassignedOnly = !state.unassignedOnly;
      e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed', state.unassignedOnly ? 'true' : 'false');
      renderTable();
      renderDetail();
    });

    function clearFilters() {
      state.search = '';
      state.severity = 'all';
      state.status = 'all';
      state.service = 'all';
      state.unassignedOnly = false;
      $('search').value = '';
      $('f-severity').value = 'all';
      $('f-status').value = 'all';
      $('f-service').value = 'all';
      $('f-unassigned').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      renderTable();
      renderDetail();
    }
    $('f-clear').addEventListener('click', clearFilters);
    el.tableEmpty.querySelector('[data-clear-filters]').addEventListener('click', clearFilters);

    el.table.querySelectorAll('.th-sort').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var key = btn.getAttribute('data-sort');
        if (state.sort.key === key) {
          state.sort.dir = state.sort.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        } else {
          state.sort.key = key;
          state.sort.dir = 'desc'; /* severity: highest first · age: oldest first */
        }
        renderTable();
      });
    });

    el.body.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var ackBtn = e.target.closest('[data-ack]');
      if (ackBtn) { e.stopPropagation(); acknowledge(ackBtn.getAttribute('data-ack')); return; }
      var row = e.target.closest('tr[data-id]');
      if (row) selectIncident(row.getAttribute('data-id'));
    });

    el.body.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      var row = e.target.closest('tr[data-id]');
      if (!row) return;
      var id = row.getAttribute('data-id');

      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        selectIncident(id);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') {
        e.preventDefault();
        acknowledge(id);
        return;
      }
      var dir = e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'j' ? 1
              : e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'k' ? -1 : 0;
      if (dir === 0) {
        if (e.key === 'Home' || e.key === 'End') {
          var list = visibleIncidents();
          if (!list.length) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          var target = e.key === 'Home' ? list[0] : list[list.length - 1];
          state.focusId = target.id;
          renderTable();
          var t = el.body.querySelector('tr[data-id="' + target.id + '"]');
          if (t) t.focus();
        }
        return;
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      var list2 = visibleIncidents();
      var idx = list2.findIndex(function (i) { return i.id === id; });
      var next = list2[Math.min(list2.length - 1, Math.max(0, idx + dir))];
      if (!next) return;
      state.focusId = next.id;
      renderTable();
      var nr = el.body.querySelector('tr[data-id="' + next.id + '"]');
      if (nr) nr.focus();
    });

    el.detail.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var ackBtn = e.target.closest('[data-ack]');
      if (ackBtn && !ackBtn.disabled) { acknowledge(ackBtn.getAttribute('data-ack'), true); return; }
      var assignBtn = e.target.closest('[data-assign]');
      if (assignBtn && !assignBtn.disabled) { assignToMe(assignBtn.getAttribute('data-assign'), true); }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      var tag = (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName) || '';
      if (e.key === '/' && !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(tag)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        $('search').focus();
      }
    });

    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
        var w = Math.floor(el.chart.clientWidth || 0);
        if (Math.abs(w - lastChartWidth) > 8) renderChart();
      });
      ro.observe(el.chart);
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
        var w = Math.floor(el.chart.clientWidth || 0);
        if (Math.abs(w - lastChartWidth) > 8) renderChart();
      });
    }
  }

  loadData(init);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Relay — Operations control room</title>
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to main content</a>

<div class="app">

  <nav class="rail" aria-label="Primary">
    <div class="rail__brand">
      <span class="rail__mark" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
          <path d="M4 12h4l2-5 3 10 2-5h5"/>
        </svg>
      </span>
      <span class="rail__wordmark">Relay</span>
    </div>

    <ul class="rail__nav">
      <li>
        <a class="rail__link is-active" href="#main" aria-current="page">
          <svg class="rail__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 10.5 12 3l9 7.5"/><path d="M5.5 9.5V20h13V9.5"/></svg>
          <span class="rail__label">Overview</span>
        </a>
      </li>
      <li>
        <a class="rail__link" href="#incidents">
          <svg class="rail__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 8v5"/><circle cx="12" cy="16.5" r="1"/><path d="M10.3 4.3 2.7 17.6A2 2 0 0 0 4.4 20.6h15.2a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 4.3a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0Z"/></svg>
          <span class="rail__label">Incidents</span>
          <span class="rail__count" id="rail-open-count" aria-hidden="true">4</span>
        </a>
      </li>
      <li>
        <a class="rail__link" href="#throughput">
          <svg class="rail__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 20V10"/><path d="M9.5 20V4"/><path d="M15 20v-8"/><path d="M20.5 20V7"/></svg>
          <span class="rail__label">Throughput</span>
        </a>
      </li>
      <li>
        <a class="rail__link" href="#incidents">
          <svg class="rail__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4" y="3.5" width="16" height="17" rx="2"/><path d="M8 8.5h8"/><path d="M8 12.5h8"/><path d="M8 16.5h5"/></svg>
          <span class="rail__label">Runbooks</span>
        </a>
      </li>
      <li>
        <a class="rail__link" href="#incidents">
          <svg class="rail__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="8.5" r="3.5"/><path d="M5 20c0-3.6 3.1-5.5 7-5.5s7 1.9 7 5.5"/></svg>
          <span class="rail__label">On-call</span>
        </a>
      </li>
    </ul>

    <div class="rail__foot">
      <p class="rail__foot-title">On-call now</p>
      <p class="rail__foot-name">A. Novak</p>
      <p class="rail__foot-meta">Primary · until 18:00 UTC</p>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar__id">
      <p class="topbar__crumb">Operations / Control room</p>
      <h1 class="topbar__title">Control room</h1>
    </div>

    <div class="topbar__status">
      <span class="status-pill" id="system-pill">
        <span class="status-pill__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="status-pill__text" id="system-pill-text">Evaluating</span>
      </span>
      <span class="topbar__clock" id="clock">--:-- UTC</span>
    </div>

    <div class="topbar__actions">
      <div class="field field--search">
        <label class="sr-only" for="search">Search incidents</label>
        <svg class="field__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"/></svg>
        <input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Search incidents" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
        <kbd class="kbd" aria-hidden="true">/</kbd>
      </div>

      <label class="sr-only" for="range">Time range</label>
      <select id="range" class="select select--compact">
        <option>Last 24 h</option>
        <option>Last 6 h</option>
        <option>Last 7 d</option>
      </select>

      <span class="avatar" title="A. Novak — primary on-call" aria-hidden="true">AN</span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main id="main" class="main">

    <section class="metrics" aria-labelledby="metrics-heading">
      <h2 class="sr-only" id="metrics-heading">Summary metrics</h2>
      <div class="metrics__grid" id="metrics"></div>
    </section>

    <section class="panel" id="throughput" aria-labelledby="thr-heading">
      <header class="panel__head">
        <div>
          <h2 class="panel__title" id="thr-heading">Throughput · 24 hours</h2>
          <p class="panel__sub">Events per minute, bucketed hourly · us-east-1</p>
        </div>
        <div class="panel__head-meta" id="chart-legend"></div>
      </header>
      <div class="chart" id="chart-wrap">
        <div class="chart__canvas" id="chart"></div>
        <div class="chart__tip" id="chart-tip" role="presentation" hidden></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="incidents" id="incidents" aria-labelledby="inc-heading">
      <div class="panel panel--table">
        <header class="panel__head panel__head--stack">
          <div>
            <h2 class="panel__title" id="inc-heading">Incidents</h2>
            <p class="panel__sub">
              <span id="result-count" aria-live="polite">4 open</span>
              <span class="panel__sub-sep" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span class="hint">↑↓ move · Enter open · A acknowledge</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter incidents">
            <label class="sr-only" for="f-severity">Severity</label>
            <select id="f-severity" class="select">
              <option value="all">All severities</option>
              <option value="critical">Critical</option>
              <option value="high">High</option>
              <option value="medium">Medium</option>
              <option value="low">Low</option>
            </select>

            <label class="sr-only" for="f-service">Service</label>
            <select id="f-service" class="select"><option value="all">All services</option></select>

            <label class="sr-only" for="f-status">Status</label>
            <select id="f-status" class="select">
              <option value="all">All statuses</option>
              <option value="open">Open</option>
              <option value="investigating">Investigating</option>
              <option value="monitoring">Monitoring</option>
              <option value="acknowledged">Acknowledged</option>
            </select>

            <button id="f-unassigned" class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Unassigned only</button>
            <button id="f-clear" class="btn btn--ghost" type="button">Clear</button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div class="table-wrap">
          <table class="table" id="incident-table" role="grid" aria-labelledby="inc-heading" aria-describedby="result-count">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" class="col-sev">
                  <button class="th-sort" type="button" data-sort="severity">Severity</button>
                </th>
                <th scope="col" class="col-id">ID</th>
                <th scope="col">Incident</th>
                <th scope="col" class="col-age num">
                  <button class="th-sort" type="button" data-sort="age">Age</button>
                </th>
                <th scope="col" class="col-owner">Owner</th>
                <th scope="col" class="col-status">Status</th>
                <th scope="col" class="col-act"><span class="sr-only">Actions</span></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="incident-body"></tbody>
          </table>
          <div class="empty" id="table-empty" hidden>
            <p class="empty__title">No incidents match these filters</p>
            <p class="empty__body">Widen the severity or status filter, or clear the search term.</p>
            <button class="btn" type="button" data-clear-filters>Clear all filters</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <aside class="panel panel--detail" id="detail" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="detail-heading">
        <h2 class="sr-only" id="detail-heading">Incident detail</h2>
        <div id="detail-body"></div>
      </aside>
    </section>
  </main>
</div>

<div class="toast-region" id="toast-region" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

hy4-preview-codebuddy/11-frontend-operations/styles.css

/* ============================================================
   Relay — operations control room
   Tokens, layout, components. Dark, neutral, single accent.
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --bg:        #0b0e13;
  --bg-2:      #0f131a;
  --panel:     #12171f;
  --panel-2:   #161d26;
  --panel-3:   #1b232e;
  --line:      #212a36;
  --line-2:    #2c3745;
  --text:      #e7ecf4;
  --text-2:    #a2adbf;
  --text-3:    #6d798c;

  --accent:      #2dd4bf;
  --accent-2:    #7defdf;
  --accent-dim:  rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.13);
  --accent-line: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.45);

  --sev-critical: #ff6b6b;
  --sev-high:     #ffab5e;
  --sev-medium:   #e8cf6b;
  --sev-low:      #8ea2ba;

  --ok:    #57d69a;
  --info:  #6ea8fe;

  --radius:   6px;
  --radius-s: 4px;
  --rail-w:   208px;
  --topbar-h: 60px;

  --mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  --sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body { height: 100%; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

h1, h2, h3, p, ul, ol, figure { margin: 0; }
ul, ol { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }

[hidden] { display: none !important; }

.sr-only {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px;
  padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0); clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute; left: 8px; top: -48px; z-index: 60;
  background: var(--accent); color: #06231f; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  text-decoration: none; transition: top 120ms ease;
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 8px; }

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
}

.num, .mono, kbd, .metric__value, .metric__delta {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ---------------- Layout ---------------- */

.app {
  min-height: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--rail-w) minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: var(--topbar-h) minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas:
    "rail topbar"
    "rail main";
}

/* ---------------- Nav rail ---------------- */

.rail {
  grid-area: rail;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 14px 10px;
  background: var(--bg-2);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.rail__brand {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 4px 8px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.rail__mark {
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: 26px; height: 26px;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-dim);
}
.rail__wordmark {
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.rail__nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }

.rail__link {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text-2);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 13px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.rail__link:hover { background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--text); }
.rail__link.is-active {
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
  border-color: var(--line-2);
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent);
  font-weight: 550;
}

.rail__icon {
  width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none;
  fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6;
  stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round;
}
.rail__label { flex: 1; }
.rail__count {
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 6px; min-width: 20px; text-align: center;
}

.rail__foot {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--panel);
}
.rail__foot-title {
  font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.rail__foot-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 3px; }
.rail__foot-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); font-family: var(--mono); }

/* ---------------- Top bar ---------------- */

.topbar {
  grid-area: topbar;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px;
  padding: 0 18px;
  background: var(--bg-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.topbar__id { min-width: 0; }
.topbar__crumb {
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.topbar__title {
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 620; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  margin-top: 1px;
}

.topbar__status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

.status-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--panel);
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.status-pill__dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--text-3);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}
.status-pill.is-degraded { border-color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.4); color: #ffb3b3; }
.status-pill.is-degraded .status-pill__dot { background: var(--sev-critical); }
.status-pill.is-attention { border-color: rgba(255, 171, 94, 0.35); color: #ffd0a3; }
.status-pill.is-attention .status-pill__dot { background: var(--sev-high); }
.status-pill.is-clear { border-color: rgba(87, 214, 154, 0.35); color: #a8e9c8; }
.status-pill.is-clear .status-pill__dot { background: var(--ok); }

.topbar__clock {
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
}

.topbar__actions {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}

.field { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.field--search { flex: 1 1 auto; max-width: 320px; min-width: 120px; }
.field__icon {
  position: absolute; left: 9px; width: 14px; height: 14px;
  fill: none; stroke: var(--text-3); stroke-width: 1.7;
  stroke-linecap: round; pointer-events: none;
}
.field input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 6px 34px 6px 28px;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text); font-size: 13px;
}
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3); }
.field input:hover { border-color: #35424f; }
.kbd {
  position: absolute; right: 7px;
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0 4px; background: var(--panel-2);
}

.select {
  appearance: none;
  padding: 6px 26px 6px 9px;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text); font-size: 12px;
  background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, var(--text-3) 50%),
                    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text-3) 50%, transparent 50%);
  background-position: calc(100% - 14px) 52%, calc(100% - 9px) 52%;
  background-size: 5px 5px, 5px 5px;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}
.select:hover { border-color: #35424f; }
.select--compact { font-size: 12px; }

.avatar {
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--panel-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

/* ---------------- Main ---------------- */

.main {
  grid-area: main;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 16px 18px 28px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
}

.panel {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  min-width: 0;
}

.panel__head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px; padding: 12px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.panel__title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 620; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.panel__sub {
  margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-3);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.panel__sub-sep { opacity: 0.5; }
.panel__head-meta { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.hint { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); }

/* ---------------- Metrics ---------------- */

.metrics__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.metric {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 11px 13px 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.metric__label {
  font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.metric__row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
.metric__value {
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.metric__delta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
  font-size: 11.5px; padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.metric__delta--good { color: var(--ok); background: rgba(87, 214, 154, 0.1); border-color: rgba(87, 214, 154, 0.25); }
.metric__delta--bad  { color: var(--sev-high); background: rgba(255, 171, 94, 0.1); border-color: rgba(255, 171, 94, 0.25); }
.metric__delta--flat { color: var(--text-2); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border-color: var(--line-2); }
.metric__foot {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px; margin-top: 2px;
}
.metric__context { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); }
.metric__spark { flex: none; display: block; }

/* ---------------- Chart ---------------- */

.chart { position: relative; padding: 10px 12px 4px; }
.chart__canvas { width: 100%; }
.chart__canvas svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

.chart__grid-line { stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart__axis { stroke: var(--line-2); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart__tick { fill: var(--text-3); font: 10px var(--mono); }
.chart__bar { fill: #2c3644; transition: fill 90ms linear; }
.chart__group:hover .chart__bar,
.chart__group.is-active .chart__bar { fill: #435163; }
.chart__bar--peak { fill: var(--accent); }
.chart__group:hover .chart__bar--peak,
.chart__group.is-active .chart__bar--peak { fill: var(--accent-2); }
.chart__hit { fill: transparent; }
.chart__avg { stroke: var(--text-3); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
.chart__avg-label { fill: var(--text-3); font: 10px var(--mono); }
.chart__peak-label { fill: var(--accent-2); font: 10px var(--mono); }

.chart__tip {
  position: absolute; z-index: 5;
  transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
  padding: 5px 8px;
  background: var(--panel-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text); white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.chart__tip b { color: var(--accent-2); font-weight: 600; }

.legend-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); }
.legend-swatch { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; background: #2c3644; }
.legend-swatch--peak { background: var(--accent); }
.legend-swatch--avg { height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--text-3); border-radius: 0; }
.legend-value { font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--text-2); }

/* ---------------- Incidents section ---------------- */

.incidents {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 356px;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: start;
}

.panel--table { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.panel__head--stack {
  flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px;
}
@media (min-width: 1080px) {
  .panel__head--stack { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
}

.filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

.chip {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.chip:hover { border-color: #3a4655; color: var(--text); }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  border-color: var(--accent-line);
  color: var(--accent-2);
}

.btn {
  padding: 5px 11px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--text);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn:hover { border-color: #3a4655; }
.btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-2); }
.btn--ghost:hover { color: var(--text); }
.btn--primary {
  background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #04231f; font-weight: 600;
}
.btn--primary:hover { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent-2); }
.btn--block { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; }
.btn[disabled], .btn[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.55; cursor: default;
  background: var(--panel-2); border-color: var(--line-2); color: var(--text-2);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.btn[disabled]:hover, .btn[aria-disabled="true"]:hover { background: var(--panel-2); border-color: var(--line-2); }

/* ---------------- Table ---------------- */

.table-wrap { position: relative; overflow-x: auto; }

.table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }

.table thead th {
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 7px 10px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  color: var(--text-3);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.th-sort {
  background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0;
  font: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; text-transform: inherit;
  color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
}
.th-sort:hover { color: var(--text); }
.th-sort::after {
  content: "";
  border: 3px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: currentColor;
  transform: translateY(2px);
  opacity: 0;
}
.table thead th[aria-sort="ascending"] .th-sort::after { opacity: 1; }
.table thead th[aria-sort="descending"] .th-sort::after { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(180deg) translateY(2px); }
.table thead th[aria-sort] .th-sort { color: var(--text); }

.table tbody tr {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--panel-2); }
.table tbody tr.is-selected { background: var(--panel-3); }
.table tbody tr.is-selected td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.table tbody tr.is-acked { color: var(--text-2); }

.table td {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  border-top: 1px solid transparent;
}
.table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

.col-sev   { width: 108px; }
.col-id    { width: 84px; }
.col-age   { width: 74px; text-align: right; }
.col-owner { width: 116px; }
.col-status{ width: 122px; }
.col-act   { width: 96px; }
th.col-age { text-align: right; }
th.col-age .th-sort { justify-content: flex-end; }

.sev {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 12px; text-transform: capitalize;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sev__dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; flex: none; }
.sev--critical { color: var(--sev-critical); }
.sev--high     { color: var(--sev-high); }
.sev--medium   { color: var(--sev-medium); }
.sev--low      { color: var(--sev-low); }

.cell-id { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); }
.cell-title { font-weight: 550; }
.cell-service { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-3); margin-top: 1px; }
.cell-age { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.cell-owner { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-2); }
.cell-owner.is-unassigned { color: var(--sev-high); font-style: normal; }

.status {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 12px; text-transform: capitalize; white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.status__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-3); flex: none; }
.status--open .status__dot          { background: var(--sev-high); }
.status--investigating .status__dot { background: var(--accent); }
.status--monitoring .status__dot    { background: var(--info); }
.status--acknowledged .status__dot  { background: var(--ok); }

.row-ack { padding: 3px 9px; font-size: 11.5px; }

/* ---------------- Empty state ---------------- */

.empty {
  padding: 34px 20px 38px;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.empty__title { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.empty__body { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-3); max-width: 42ch; }
.empty .btn { margin-top: 10px; }

/* ---------------- Detail panel ---------------- */

.panel--detail { position: sticky; top: 16px; }

.detail__head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.detail__id { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); }
.detail__title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 620; margin-top: 3px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.detail__badges { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; }

.badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  font-size: 11px; text-transform: capitalize; white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.badge--critical { color: var(--sev-critical); border-color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.35); background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.08); }
.badge--high     { color: var(--sev-high);     border-color: rgba(255, 171, 94, 0.35);  background: rgba(255, 171, 94, 0.08); }
.badge--medium   { color: var(--sev-medium);   border-color: rgba(232, 207, 107, 0.3);  background: rgba(232, 207, 107, 0.07); }
.badge--low      { color: var(--sev-low);      border-color: var(--line-2);             background: rgba(142, 162, 186, 0.07); }
.badge__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

.detail__section { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.detail__section:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.detail__label {
  font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  color: var(--text-3); margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.kv {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 6px 12px; font-size: 12.5px;
}
.kv dt { color: var(--text-3); }
.kv dd { margin: 0; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.kv dd.is-text { font-family: var(--sans); }

.signals { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
.signal {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.signal__name { color: var(--text-2); }
.signal__value { font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.signal__value.is-bad { color: var(--sev-high); }
.signal__value.is-warn { color: var(--sev-medium); }
.signal__bar {
  height: 3px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--line); overflow: hidden;
}
.signal__bar > span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); }

.timeline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
.timeline__item {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 0 12px 16px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.timeline__item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; border-left-color: transparent; }
.timeline__item::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: -4px; top: 5px;
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
}
.timeline__item.is-key::before { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.timeline__time { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); }
.timeline__text { color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.4; }

.detail__actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; }
.detail__actions-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.detail__actions-row .btn { flex: 1; }
.detail__note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); text-align: center; }

/* ---------------- Toast ---------------- */

.toast-region {
  position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 50;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.toast {
  min-width: 220px; max-width: 320px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  background: var(--panel-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  animation: toast-in 140ms ease-out;
}
.toast b { font-weight: 600; }
@keyframes toast-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

/* ---------------- Responsive ---------------- */

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .incidents { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; }
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .incidents { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .panel--detail { position: static; }
  .metrics__grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .app {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-areas:
      "rail"
      "topbar"
      "main";
  }
  .rail {
    flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  .rail__brand { padding: 0 8px 0 4px; border-bottom: 0; }
  .rail__nav { flex-direction: row; gap: 2px; }
  .rail__link { padding: 6px 10px; }
  .rail__label, .rail__foot { display: none; }
  .rail__count { display: none; }

  .topbar {
    height: auto; padding: 8px 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 12px;
  }
  .topbar__status { order: 3; width: 100%; }
  .topbar__actions { width: 100%; }
  .field--search { max-width: none; }

  .main { padding: 12px 12px 24px; }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .metrics__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }

  /* Table becomes a stack of cards */
  .table thead { display: none; }
  .table, .table tbody, .table tr, .table td { display: block; width: 100%; }
  .table tr {
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin: 10px;
    padding: 4px 0;
    background: var(--panel);
  }
  .table tr.is-selected { border-color: var(--accent-line); }
  .table td {
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 14px; padding: 5px 12px;
    border: 0;
  }
  .table td::before {
    content: attr(data-label);
    flex: none;
    font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .table td.cell-main { padding-top: 8px; }
  .table td.col-act { padding-bottom: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .table td.col-act::before { display: none; }
  .table td:first-child { box-shadow: none !important; }
  .table tr.is-selected td:first-child { box-shadow: none !important; }
  .table tr.is-selected { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
  .table-wrap { overflow-x: visible; }
  .empty { margin: 0 10px 10px; border: 1px dashed var(--line-2); border-radius: var(--radius); }
}

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .main { padding: 10px 10px 22px; }
  .panel__head { padding: 10px 12px; }
  .filters .select { flex: 1 1 120px; }
  .detail__actions-row { flex-direction: column; }
  .kv { grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation-duration: 1ms !important; transition-duration: 1ms !important; }
}

Evaluation 7.75 / 10 graded blind as submission A

Light, restrained blue-accent dashboard with clear metric strip, zero-based bar chart, dense table and rich detail panel (signals, timeline). Everything works, but the 390 px card layout overlaps the Service and Age fields, and focus is dropped to <body> after acknowledging.

Strengths

  • Search, severity and status filters all work; empty state reads 'No incidents match these filters' with Clear all filters
  • Acknowledge disables the button ('Acknowledged ✓'), updates the row status and announces 'INC-2839 acknowledged. Status is now Acknowledged.' via live region
  • Skip link, labelled controls, focusable rows with visible 2px outline, caption on table

Weaknesses

  • Mobile incident cards overlap: AGE label/value drawn on top of SERVICE ('31m' over 'event-router')
  • Focus lands on BODY after Acknowledge (button re-rendered)
  • Invented detail content (signals, timeline, playbook RB-114) and assumed 'thousands' units on chart
  • 13 text nodes under 4.5:1 (e.g. 'vs prev hr' 3.07:1)
Evidence the grader checked
  • out/A-mrow.png (tr:has-text('EU retry') at 390px) shows AGE/SERVICE overlapping
  • probe2: focusAfterAck=BODY; rowAfter 'HIGH EU retry queue growth ... D. Reyes Acknowledged'
  • probe.js: webhooks search -> only INC-2832/2839 rows; High filter -> INC-2839 only
  • mobile nav rail scrolls horizontally inside (NAV.rail 527/390), no page overflow
  • probe.js/probe2.js (Playwright, 1440x900 and 390x844, served over 127.0.0.1)

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

muse/11-frontend-operations/RESPONSE.md

Relay — design response

Visual hierarchy

The page reads top-to-bottom in operator priority order: system state → key numbers → trends → work queue → work item.

  1. Top status bar — brand, environment (PROD), a computed active-alert pill, live indicator, UTC clock, and the on-call operator. Sticky so state is always visible.
  2. Summary metrics — four compact cards (Events/min, P95 latency, Error rate, Queue depth) with delta-vs-previous-hour context. Color encodes good/bad, arrows encode direction, so color is never the only signal.
  3. Throughput chart — 24-hour hourly means as an inline SVG bar chart with gridlines, UTC hour ticks, and a peak annotation.
  4. Incident table — the work queue: severity badge, incident, service, age, owner, status.
  5. Detail panel — sticky on desktop; the selected incident with signals, timeline, and actions.

The palette is neutral gray surfaces with a single blue accent reserved for selection, focus, links, and the peak bar. Severity/status each have distinct hue + label pairings (never color alone), with a dark theme via CSS variables.

Interaction behavior

  • Filters — live text search (ID/title/service/owner) plus severity and status selects. The result count updates (N of M shown); a clear-filters button appears only while filtered.
  • Row selection — click, Enter/Space, or ↑/↓ arrow keys move selection; the detail panel updates immediately. If a filter hides the selected row, selection moves to the first visible row.
  • Acknowledge — sets status to Acknowledged, assigns the on-call operator when unassigned, appends a "just now" timeline entry, refreshes the row, the status-bar alert count, and disables the button with confirmation text.
  • Copy ID — copies the incident ID with a clipboard-API fallback.
  • Chart tooltip — hovering a bar shows its hour and value; every bar also carries a native <title> fallback.
  • Theme toggle — light/dark switch in the rail, persisted in localStorage.
  • Empty states — zero filter matches swap the table for an illustrated empty state with guidance and a clear-filters action.

Accessibility choices

  • Skip link, landmark regions (nav, main, aside), and a real <table> with <th scope> headers.
  • Chart is role="img" with <title>/<desc> summary plus a visually hidden data table of all 24 values for screen readers.
  • Selection and filter changes are announced through a polite aria-live region; rows expose aria-selected.
  • Visible :focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements; arrow-key navigation in the table with a documented hint row.
  • prefers-reduced-motion disables the live-dot pulse; numeric columns use tabular figures for scannability.
  • Mobile (390 px): the rail becomes a horizontal strip, metrics go 2-up, and table rows reflow into labeled cards — no horizontal page scroll.

muse/11-frontend-operations/TASK.md

Task 11 — Frontend design: operations control room

Build a polished, responsive single-page operations dashboard called Relay using only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, package installs, external fonts, remote assets, or network requests.

Visual direction: calm, high-density control-room software for expert operators. Use a restrained neutral palette with one purposeful accent, excellent numeric alignment, compact spacing, and clear severity states. Avoid glassmorphism, decorative gradients, giant headings, and excessive rounded cards.

The page must include:

  • A navigation rail and top status bar.
  • Four summary metrics with trend context.
  • A 24-hour throughput visualization made with semantic HTML, CSS, canvas, or inline SVG.
  • A filterable incident table with severity, service, age, owner, and status.
  • A detail panel for the selected incident and a working acknowledge action.
  • Useful empty/filter states and visible keyboard focus.
  • A mobile layout that remains usable at 390 px without horizontal page scroll.

Seed realistic content from DATA.json. Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the hierarchy, interaction behavior, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

muse/11-frontend-operations/app.js

/* Relay dashboard — vanilla JS. Data below is seeded from DATA.json
   (inlined so the page works offline with zero network requests). */
