<div class="app">
  <nav class="rail" aria-label="Primary">
    <div class="rail__brand">
      <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">R</span>
      <span class="rail__brandtext">
        <strong>Relay</strong>
        <span class="rail__env">prod-eu</span>
      </span>
    </div>

    <ul class="rail__nav" id="railNav">
      <li><button type="button" class="rail__item is-active" aria-current="page"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-overview"/></svg><span>Overview</span></button></li>
      <li><button type="button" class="rail__item"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-incidents"/></svg><span>Incidents</span><span class="rail__badge" id="railBadge">0</span></button></li>
      <li><button type="button" class="rail__item"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-streams"/></svg><span>Streams</span></button></li>
      <li><button type="button" class="rail__item"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-services"/></svg><span>Services</span></button></li>
      <li><button type="button" class="rail__item"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-runbooks"/></svg><span>Runbooks</span></button></li>
      <li><button type="button" class="rail__item"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-settings"/></svg><span>Settings</span></button></li>
    </ul>

    <div class="rail__foot">
      <span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">AN</span>
      <span class="rail__user">
        <strong>A. Novak</strong>
        <span>Primary on-call</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <div class="shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="topbar__lead">
        <div class="topbar__titles">
          <p class="crumbs"><span>EU-West</span><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span>Relay platform</span></p>
          <h1>Operations control room</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="topbar__meta">
        <p class="health" id="healthPill">
          <span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="health__label">Checking…</span>
        </p>
        <p class="clock"><span class="clock__time" id="clockTime">--:--:--</span><span class="clock__zone">UTC</span></p>
        <button type="button" class="iconbtn" id="themeBtn" aria-pressed="true" title="Switch to light theme">
          <span class="sr-only">Toggle colour theme</span>
          <svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-moon"/></svg>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="iconbtn" id="notifyBtn">
          <span class="sr-only">Notifications</span>
          <svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-bell"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main class="content" id="main" tabindex="-1">
      <section class="metrics" id="metrics" aria-label="Summary metrics"></section>

      <section class="panel chart" aria-labelledby="chartTitle">
        <header class="panel__head">
          <div>
            <h2 class="panel__title" id="chartTitle">Throughput — last 24 hours</h2>
            <p class="panel__sub">Ingest events per minute, thousands. Hourly buckets, UTC.</p>
          </div>
          <dl class="chart__stats">
            <div><dt>Peak</dt><dd id="chartPeak">—</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Mean</dt><dd id="chartMean">—</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Total</dt><dd id="chartTotal">—</dd></div>
          </dl>
        </header>
        <div class="chart__wrap" id="chartWrap">
          <div class="chart__tip" id="chartTip" role="status" aria-live="off" hidden></div>
        </div>
        <footer class="chart__foot">
          <p class="legend"><span class="legend__swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span>Ingest rate</p>
          <p class="chart__hint">Hover or focus a bar for the hourly reading.</p>
        </footer>
      </section>

      <div class="workarea">
        <section class="panel table-panel" aria-labelledby="incidentTitle">
          <header class="panel__head panel__head--tight">
            <div>
              <h2 class="panel__title" id="incidentTitle">Incident queue</h2>
              <p class="panel__sub" id="resultCount" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading…</p>
            </div>
          </header>

          <div class="toolbar">
            <div class="field field--search">
              <svg class="icon field__icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>
              <input type="search" id="searchInput" placeholder="Filter by id, title, service, owner" aria-label="Search incidents" autocomplete="off" />
            </div>
            <div class="chips" role="group" aria-label="Filter by severity" id="severityChips"></div>
            <div class="field">
              <label class="sr-only" for="statusFilter">Filter by status</label>
              <select id="statusFilter">
                <option value="all">All statuses</option>
                <option value="open">Open</option>
                <option value="investigating">Investigating</option>
                <option value="acknowledged">Acknowledged</option>
                <option value="monitoring">Monitoring</option>
                <option value="resolved">Resolved</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label class="sr-only" for="serviceFilter">Filter by service</label>
              <select id="serviceFilter"></select>
            </div>
            <label class="check">
              <input type="checkbox" id="unassignedOnly" />
              <span>Unassigned only</span>
            </label>
            <label class="check">
              <input type="checkbox" id="hideResolved" checked />
              <span>Hide resolved</span>
            </label>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" id="clearFilters" hidden>Clear filters</button>
          </div>

          <div class="table-scroll">
            <table class="grid" id="incidentTable" role="grid" aria-labelledby="incidentTitle" aria-describedby="gridHelp">
              <caption class="sr-only" id="gridHelp">Incident queue. Use the arrow keys to move between rows and Enter to open an incident in the detail panel.</caption>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col" role="columnheader" class="col-sev" aria-sort="none"><button type="button" class="sortbtn" data-sort="severity">Sev<span class="sortmark" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                  <th scope="col" role="columnheader" class="col-id" aria-sort="none"><button type="button" class="sortbtn" data-sort="id">Incident<span class="sortmark" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                  <th scope="col" role="columnheader" class="col-service" aria-sort="none"><button type="button" class="sortbtn" data-sort="service">Service<span class="sortmark" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                  <th scope="col" class="col-age num" aria-sort="none"><button type="button" class="sortbtn" data-sort="age">Age<span class="sortmark" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                  <th scope="col" class="col-owner" aria-sort="none"><button type="button" class="sortbtn" data-sort="owner">Owner<span class="sortmark" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                  <th scope="col" class="col-status" aria-sort="none"><button type="button" class="sortbtn" data-sort="status">Status<span class="sortmark" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody id="incidentBody"></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <div class="empty" id="emptyState" hidden>
            <p class="empty__title">No incidents match these filters</p>
            <p class="empty__body" id="emptyDesc">Try widening the severity range or clearing the search text.</p>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" id="emptyClear">Clear all filters</button>
          </div>

          <div class="allclear" id="allClear" hidden>
            <svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>
            <p>No open incidents in this window. The queue is clear.</p>
          </div>
        </section>

        <aside class="panel detail" id="detailPanel" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="detailHeading" aria-live="polite">
          <h2 class="sr-only" id="detailHeading">Incident detail</h2>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="toasts" id="toasts" role="region" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Notifications"></div>

<script src="app.js" defer></script>
</body>
</html>

hy4-preview/11-frontend-operations/styles.css

/* Relay — operations control room
   Tokens first, then layout, then components. No external assets. */

:root {
  --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;

  --rail: 236px;
  --detail: 348px;
  --gap: 14px;

  --r-sm: 3px;
  --r-md: 5px;

  --fs-xs: 11px;
  --fs-sm: 12px;
  --fs-md: 13px;
  --fs-lg: 15px;

  --dur: 120ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.13, 1);
}

/* ---------- Dark theme (default) ---------- */
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --bg: #0c0e11;
  --surface: #14171c;
  --surface-2: #181c22;
  --surface-3: #1d222a;
  --line: #262c35;
  --line-soft: #1e232a;
  --text: #e7eaef;
  --text-dim: #9ba4b1;
  --text-mute: #6b7480;
  --accent: #57a0ff;
  --accent-soft: rgba(87, 160, 255, 0.14);
  --accent-line: rgba(87, 160, 255, 0.45);
  --sev-critical: #f4595f;
  --sev-high: #f2994a;
  --sev-medium: #d8b246;
  --sev-low: #7c8896;
  --ok: #46b95c;
  --shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --grid-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
}

/* ---------- Light theme ---------- */
:root[data-theme="light"] {
  color-scheme: light;
  --bg: #eef1f5;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f6f8fa;
  --surface-3: #eef1f5;
  --line: #d8dee6;
  --line-soft: #e7ebf1;
  --text: #14181e;
  --text-dim: #56616f;
  --text-mute: #7d8896;
  --accent: #1668e3;
  --accent-soft: rgba(22, 104, 227, 0.1);
  --accent-line: rgba(22, 104, 227, 0.35);
  --sev-critical: #cf2f36;
  --sev-high: #b45c0b;
  --sev-medium: #8a6a06;
  --sev-low: #67748a;
  --ok: #1f7a3d;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.06);
  --grid-line: rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.08);
}

/* ---------- Base ---------- */
* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body { height: 100%; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  line-height: 1.45;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

h1, h2, h3, p, dl, dd, dt, ul, figure { margin: 0; }
ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; }
button, input, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }

.num, .metric__value, .metric__delta, td.age, .kv dd, .chart__stats dd, th.num {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
}

.sprite { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; overflow: hidden; }

.icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: none; fill: currentColor; }
.icon .stroke { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round; }

.sr-only {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

:where(a, button, input, select, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
}
:where(a, button, input, select, [tabindex]):focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none; }

.skip-link {
  position: absolute; left: 8px; top: -48px; z-index: 40;
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-md); text-decoration: none;
  transition: top var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 8px; }

/* ---------- App shell ---------- */
.app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--rail) minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 100vh; }

.rail {
  position: sticky; top: 0; align-self: start; height: 100vh;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--surface); border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 14px 10px 10px;
}
.rail__brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 6px 16px; }
.brand-mark {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--surface);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
}
.rail__brandtext { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.2; }
.rail__brandtext strong { font-size: var(--fs-lg); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.rail__env { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

.rail__nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
.rail__item {
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 7px 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), color var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.rail__item:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
.rail__item.is-active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--text); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.rail__item.is-active .icon { color: var(--accent); }
.rail__badge {
  margin-left: auto; min-width: 18px; text-align: center;
  font-size: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--sev-critical); color: #fff;
}
.rail__badge[data-empty="true"] { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-mute); }

.rail__foot {
  margin-top: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 10px 8px 2px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
}
.avatar {
  width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.rail__user { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.25; min-width: 0; }
.rail__user strong { font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; }
.rail__user span { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); }

.shell { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

/* ---------- Top bar ---------- */
.topbar {
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 18px; background: var(--surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.topbar__lead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.topbar__titles { min-width: 0; }
.crumbs {
  display: flex; gap: 6px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute);
  font-family: var(--font-mono); text-transform: lowercase;
}
.topbar h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-lg); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.topbar__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.health {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 3px 9px 3px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 11px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-dim);
  background: var(--surface-2); white-space: nowrap;
}
.health .dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-mute); }
.health[data-state="degraded"] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sev-high) 45%, var(--line)); color: var(--text); }
.health[data-state="degraded"] .dot { background: var(--sev-high); }
.health[data-state="critical"] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sev-critical) 55%, var(--line)); color: var(--text); }
.health[data-state="critical"] .dot { background: var(--sev-critical); }
.health[data-state="ok"] .dot { background: var(--ok); }

.clock {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-dim);
}
.clock__time { color: var(--text); font-size: var(--fs-md); }
.clock__zone { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-mute); }

.iconbtn {
  width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--text-dim);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), color var(--dur) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.iconbtn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line); }

/* ---------- Content ---------- */
.content {
  padding: 16px 18px 22px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--gap);
  min-width: 0;
}
.content:focus { outline: none; }

.panel {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  min-width: 0;
}
.panel__head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
}
.panel__head--tight { padding-bottom: 10px; }
.panel__title { font-size: var(--fs-md); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; }
.panel__sub { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); margin-top: 2px; }

/* ---------- Metrics ---------- */
.metrics {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--gap);
}
.metric {
  background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 11px 13px 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0;
}
.metric__label {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  color: var(--text-mute); font-weight: 600;
}
.metric__row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.metric__value {
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1;
}
.metric__delta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
}
.metric__delta[data-tone="good"] { color: var(--ok); }
.metric__delta[data-tone="bad"] { color: var(--sev-critical); }
.metric__delta[data-tone="neutral"] { color: var(--text-dim); }
.metric__arrow { font-size: 9px; line-height: 1; }
.metric__spark { display: block; width: 100%; height: 22px; overflow: visible; }
.metric__note { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); }

/* ---------- Chart ---------- */
.chart__stats { display: flex; gap: 18px; }
.chart__stats div { text-align: right; }
.chart__stats dt { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--text-mute); }
.chart__stats dd { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-md); font-weight: 600; }

.chart__wrap { padding: 10px 8px 0; }
.chart__plot { position: relative; }
.chart { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.chart .grid-line { stroke: var(--grid-line); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart .axis-label { fill: var(--text-mute); font-size: 9px; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.chart .area { fill: var(--accent-soft); stroke: none; }
.chart .line { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
.chart .avg-line { stroke: var(--text-mute); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
.chart .peak-dot { fill: var(--surface); stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2; }
.chart .bar { fill: transparent; }
.chart .bar:hover { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent); }
.chart .hit { fill: transparent; cursor: crosshair; }
.chart .hit:focus-visible { fill: var(--accent-soft); outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }

.chart__tip {
  position: absolute; z-index: 5; pointer-events: none;
  transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
  background: var(--surface-3); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 5px 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-xs); white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.chart__tip b { font-size: var(--fs-sm); }

.chart__foot {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  padding: 6px 14px 11px;
}
.legend { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-dim); }
.legend__swatch { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); }
.chart__hint { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); }

/* ---------- Work area ---------- */
.workarea {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--detail);
  gap: var(--gap); align-items: start; min-width: 0;
}

/* ---------- Toolbar ---------- */
.toolbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
}
.field { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.field--search { flex: 1 1 190px; max-width: 280px; min-width: 0; }
.field__icon { position: absolute; left: 8px; color: var(--text-mute); pointer-events: none; }
.field input[type="search"],
.field select {
  background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 5px 8px; font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  min-width: 0; width: 100%;
}
.field input[type="search"] { padding-left: 26px; }
.field select { padding-right: 22px; appearance: none; cursor: pointer;
  background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, var(--text-mute) 50%),
                    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text-mute) 50%, transparent 50%);
  background-position: calc(100% - 13px) 11px, calc(100% - 9px) 11px;
  background-size: 4px 4px, 4px 4px; background-repeat: no-repeat;
}
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-mute); }
.field input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-cancel-button { filter: grayscale(1) opacity(0.6); }

.chips { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.chip {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-dim);
  border-radius: 11px; padding: 3px 9px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), color var(--dur) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.chip:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--text-mute); }
.chip__sw { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent-line); color: var(--text); }

.check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-dim); cursor: pointer; }
.check input { accent-color: var(--accent); width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.check:hover { color: var(--text); }

.btn {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 5px 11px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background var(--dur) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur) var(--ease), opacity var(--dur) var(--ease);
}
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--text-mute); }
.btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim); }
.btn--ghost:hover { color: var(--text); }
.btn--primary {
  background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--surface); font-weight: 600;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn--primary { color: #08101c; }
.btn--primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
.btn:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ---------- Table ---------- */
.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 620px; table-layout: fixed; }
.col-sev { width: 74px; }
.col-id { width: auto; }
.col-service { width: 128px; }
.col-age { width: 78px; }
.col-owner { width: 104px; }

.grid thead th {

  background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-align: left; padding: 0;

}
.sortbtn {

}

.sortmark { opacity: 0; font-size: 8px; }

th[aria-sort="ascending"] .sortmark, th[aria-sort="descending"] .sortmark { opacity: 1; color: var(--accent); }
th[aria-sort="ascending"] .sortmark::after { content: " ▲"; }
th[aria-sort="descending"] .sortmark::after { content: " ▼"; }

th.num[aria-sort="ascending"] .sortmark::after { content: " ▲"; }

.sev[data-sev="medium"] { --sev: var(--sev-medium); }

.cell-id { min-width: 150px; }
.cell-id .id {

}

td.age { text-align: right; color: var(--text-dim); white-space: nowrap; }
.cell-owner { white-space: nowrap; color: var(--text-dim); }

.cell-status { white-space: nowrap; }
.status {

}

}
.status[data-status="open"]::before { background: var(--sev-critical); }
.status[data-status="investigating"]::before { background: var(--accent); }
.status[data-status="acknowledged"]::before { background: var(--ok); }
.status[data-status="monitoring"]::before { background: var(--sev-medium); }
.status[data-status="resolved"]::before { background: var(--text-mute); }

.grid tbody tr:focus-visible {

}

/* ---------- Empty / clear states ---------- */

}

/* ---------- Detail panel ---------- */
.detail { padding: 0; min-width: 0; }
.detail__empty { padding: 34px 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-mute); font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
.detail__empty .kbd-hint { margin-top: 10px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); }

.detail__head { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }
.detail__topline { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.detail__id { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-dim); }

  margin-left: auto; width: 24px; height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--text-mute); cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1;
}

.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 7px 12px; padding: 12px 14px; }
.kv dt { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

.detail__section { padding: 12px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }

  font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;

}

.timeline time { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-mute); text-align: right; }

.notes {

  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-dim);
}

.actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; padding: 12px 14px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }

  display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-dim);
}
.ack-state .icon { color: var(--ok); margin-top: 3px; }

/* ---------- Toasts ---------- */
.toasts {
  position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 60;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none; max-width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 32px));
}
.toast {
  background: var(--surface-3); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 9px 12px; font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  animation: toast-in 160ms var(--ease);
}
.toast[data-kind="ok"] { border-left-color: var(--ok); }
.toast[data-kind="warn"] { border-left-color: var(--sev-high); }
.toast strong { display: block; font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; }
.toast span { color: var(--text-mute); font-size: var(--fs-xs); }
@keyframes toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1240px) {
  :root { --rail: 68px; }
  .rail__brandtext, .rail__item span:not(.rail__badge), .rail__user { display: none; }
  .rail { padding: 14px 10px 10px; align-items: center; }
  .rail__brand { padding: 0 0 16px; }
  .rail__item { justify-content: center; padding: 9px 0; position: relative; }
  .rail__item.is-active { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
  .rail__badge { position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 6px; margin: 0; }
  .rail__foot { justify-content: center; }
}

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .workarea { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .app { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .rail {
    position: static; height: auto; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 0 8px; overflow-x: auto;
  }
  .rail__brand { padding: 8px 6px 8px 2px; }
  .rail__nav { flex-direction: row; gap: 2px; }
  .rail__item { padding: 9px 10px; box-shadow: none !important; }
  .rail__item.is-active { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent) !important; border-radius: 0; }
  .rail__badge { position: static; margin-left: 6px; }
  .rail__foot { margin: 0 0 0 auto; padding: 6px 2px; border-top: 0; }
  .rail__foot .avatar { display: grid; }
  .detail { order: 2; }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .content, .topbar { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px; }
  .topbar { gap: 8px; }
  .clock__zone, .crumbs { display: none; }
  .panel__head { flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .chart__stats { gap: 14px; }
  .toolbar { padding: 10px 12px; }
  .field--search { flex: 1 1 100%; max-width: none; }
  .kv { grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .toasts { right: 10px; left: 10px; bottom: 10px; align-items: stretch; max-width: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
  .metric { padding: 9px 10px 10px; }
  .metric__value { font-size: 19px; }
  .metric__spark { height: 18px; }
  .metric__note { display: none; }
  .rail__item span:not(.rail__badge) { font-size: var(--fs-xs); }
  .topbar h1 { font-size: var(--fs-md); }
  .col-owner, .cell-owner { display: none; }
  .grid { min-width: 480px; }
  .col-sev { width: 66px; }
  .col-status { width: 108px; }
  .actions .btn { flex: 1 1 100%; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; }
}

Evaluation 5.5 / 10 graded blind as submission C

Dark generic dashboard with a non-zero-based line chart (ticks 20/37/54/71/88), a table without incident IDs, and a placeholder 'On-call roster loads here.' card. Functions over http but renders blank from file://, and its icon-only nav links have no accessible names.

Strengths

  • Filters, row click and Acknowledge work; row status becomes 'Acknowledged'
  • Empty state 'No incidents match the current filters.' appears on no-match search

Weaknesses

  • Page is empty when index.html is opened directly (fetch of DATA.json, no fallback)
  • Five nav links have no accessible name; no h1; 28 of 63 text nodes below 4.5:1
  • Mobile table hides Title and Owner columns; filter labels cramped
  • Content stops at ~1316px leaving a dead strip at 1440; leftover placeholder card
  • Focus lost to BODY after Acknowledge
Evidence the grader checked
  • f.js file:// load: C rendered 0 of 4 incident titles and no metrics
  • probe.js unlabeled: ['A','A','A','A','A']; landmarks h1=0
  • C-mobile-full.png: table columns SEVERITY/SERVICE/AGE/STATUS only; 'On-call roster loads here.'
  • C-desktop.png y-axis 20..88
  • probe.js/probe2.js (Playwright, 1440x900 and 390x844, served over 127.0.0.1)

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

deepseek-v4-pro/11-frontend-operations/RESPONSE.md

Relay — operations control room

Hierarchy

The page is organized as a single application shell with four regions that roughly follow a top-left → bottom-right reading path for scanning work:

  1. Navigation rail (left) — primary destinations. Compact, icon-only, with an active-state indicator and aria-current="page".
  2. Top status bar — identity (Relay / Operations), environment (prod), live-sync dot, a UTC clock, and region. Non-interactive status, kept visually quiet.
  3. Content area — the working surface, ordered by operational priority:
    • Summary metrics (four KPI cards with trend context),
    • 24-hour throughput chart,
    • Incidents table with filters and a sticky detail panel,
    • On-call roster placeholder.

Dominance is established via size and weight only: metric values are the largest numerals, the incident table is the widest region, and the accent color (blue) is reserved for the current selection and primary action so it doesn't compete with severity colors.

Interaction behavior

  • Incident selection — clicking a row (or pressing Enter/Space while the row is focused) sets it as the selected incident via aria-selected, applies a left accent bar, and populates the detail panel.
  • Acknowledge — the detail panel's button flips the incident status to acknowledged, updates the shared table/detail state, and shows a transient toast. The action is idempotent; once acknowledged the button becomes disabled.
  • Filters — severity and status dropdowns plus a free-text search (matches id, service, owner, and title) filter the table live. When no rows match, an explicit empty state is shown. Filters combine (AND).
  • Rendering — the table and detail panel are full re-renders driven by a small in-memory state object, keeping the acknowledge action trivially correct.

Accessibility choices

  • Skip link to bypass the rail/topbar and jump to #main.
  • Keyboard visibility — a single high-contrast :focus-visible outline script (--focus) is applied to all interactive elements, and the currently selected table row also uses a non-color indicator (the inset accent bar), so selection does not rely on color alone.
  • Semantics — real <table> with proper <th scope="col">, <nav>, <section>/aria-labelledby, role="list"/listitem for the metric grid, and role="status" on the toast so acknowledge feedback is announced.
  • Chart — the SVG uses role="img" with a descriptive aria-label so the visualization has a text alternative; axis labels are text (not images).
  • Status/states — severity and status are always paired with text labels, not color alone; trend direction is additionally exposed via aria-label.
  • Contrast & motion — dark, restrained palette chosen for sustained reading; no motion other than a subtle focus transition; prefers-reduced-motion is respected implicitly since no animated content is used.

Responsive behavior

Below 720 px the rail becomes a horizontal top bar, secondary topbar items are hidden, the metric grid collapses to two columns, the incident table hides the less critical Title/Owner columns, and the detail panel moves below the table (no longer sticky). At 390 px the layout fits without horizontal page scroll.

deepseek-v4-pro/11-frontend-operations/TASK.md

Task 11 — Frontend design: operations control room

Build a polished, responsive single-page operations dashboard called Relay using only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, package installs, external fonts, remote assets, or network requests.

Visual direction: calm, high-density control-room software for expert operators. Use a restrained neutral palette with one purposeful accent, excellent numeric alignment, compact spacing, and clear severity states. Avoid glassmorphism, decorative gradients, giant headings, and excessive rounded cards.

The page must include:

  • A navigation rail and top status bar.
  • Four summary metrics with trend context.
  • A 24-hour throughput visualization made with semantic HTML, CSS, canvas, or inline SVG.
  • A filterable incident table with severity, service, age, owner, and status.
  • A detail panel for the selected incident and a working acknowledge action.
  • Useful empty/filter states and visible keyboard focus.
  • A mobile layout that remains usable at 390 px without horizontal page scroll.

Seed realistic content from DATA.json. Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the hierarchy, interaction behavior, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

deepseek-v4-pro/11-frontend-operations/app.js

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var state = {
    incidents: [],
    filters: { severity: "all", status: "all", query: "" },
    selectedId: null
  };

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  function loadData() {
    return fetch("DATA.json", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
  }

  /* ----- metrics ----- */
  function renderMetrics(metrics) {
    metrics.forEach(function (m, i) {
      var value = document.querySelector('[data-metric="' + i + '"]');
      if (!value) return;
      value.textContent = m.value;
      var trend = value.nextElementSibling;
      trend.textContent = m.change;
      trend.className = "trend " + (m.direction === "up" ? "trend-up" : "trend-down");
      trend.setAttribute("aria-label", (m.direction === "up" ? "up " : "down ") + m.change);
    });
  }

  /* ----- throughput chart ----- */
  function renderChart(data) {
    var svg = document.getElementById("spark");
    if (!svg) return;
    svg.textContent = "";

    var W = 720, H = 220;
    var PL = 44, PR = 16, PT = 16, PB = 28;
    var iw = W - PL - PR, ih = H - PT - PB;
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, data);
    var min = Math.min.apply(null, data);
    var range = (max - min) || 1;

    function x(i) { return PL + (i / (data.length - 1)) * iw; }
    function y(v) { return PT + ih - ((v - min) / range) * ih; }

    var ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
    function make(tag, attrs) {
      var n = document.createElementNS(ns, tag);
      for (var k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
      return n;
    }

    var gridStep = 4;
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i <= gridStep; i++) {
      var gv = min + (max - min) * (i / gridStep);
      var gy = y(gv);
      svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: PL, y1: gy, x2: W - PR, y2: gy, "class": "gridline" }));
      var t = make("text", { x: PL - 8, y: gy + 3, "class": "label", "text-anchor": "end" });
      t.textContent = Math.round(gv);
      svg.appendChild(t);
    }

    var points = data.map(function (v, i) { return [x(i), y(v)]; });

    var areaPath = "M" + points[0][0] + "," + y(min) + " L" +
      points.map(function (p) { return p[0] + "," + p[1]; }).join(" L") +
      " L" + points[points.length - 1][0] + "," + y(min) + " Z";
    svg.appendChild(make("path", { d: areaPath, "class": "area" }));

    var linePath = "M" + points.map(function (p) { return p[0] + "," + p[1]; }).join(" L");
    svg.appendChild(make("path", { d: linePath, "class": "line" }));

    svg.appendChild(make("circle", { cx: points[points.length - 1][0], cy: points[points.length - 1][1], r: 3.5, "class": "dot" }));

    var labelL = make("text", { x: PL, y: H - 8, "class": "label" });
    labelL.textContent = "00:00";
    svg.appendChild(labelL);
    var labelM = make("text", { x: PL + iw / 2, y: H - 8, "class": "label", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    labelM.textContent = "12:00";
    svg.appendChild(labelM);
    var labelR = make("text", { x: W - PR, y: H - 8, "class": "label", "text-anchor": "end" });
    labelR.textContent = "24:00";
    svg.appendChild(labelR);
  }

  /* ----- incidents ----- */
  function normalizeStatus(status) {
    return status ? status.toLowerCase() : "";
  }

  function matchesFilters(inc) {
    var q = state.filters.query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      var hay = (inc.id + " " + inc.service + " " + inc.owner + " " + inc.title).toLowerCase();
      if (hay.indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
    }
    if (state.filters.severity !== "all" && inc.severity !== state.filters.severity) return false;
    if (state.filters.status !== "all" && normalizeStatus(inc.status) !== state.filters.status) return false;
    return true;
  }

  function renderTable() {
    var body = document.getElementById("incident-body");
    var empty = document.getElementById("empty-state");
    body.textContent = "";

    var visible = state.incidents.filter(matchesFilters);
    empty.hidden = visible.length > 0;

    visible.forEach(function (inc) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.tabIndex = 0;
      tr.setAttribute("data-id", inc.id);
      tr.setAttribute("aria-selected", state.selectedId === inc.id ? "true" : "false");
      if (state.selectedId === inc.id) tr.className = "is-selected";

      var sevCell = document.createElement("td");
      var sev = el("span", "sev sev-" + inc.severity, inc.severity);
      sevCell.appendChild(sev);

      var svc = document.createElement("td");
      svc.textContent = inc.service;

      var title = document.createElement("td");
      title.textContent = inc.title;

      var age = document.createElement("td");
      age.textContent = inc.age;
      age.className = "num";

      var owner = document.createElement("td");
      owner.textContent = inc.owner;

      var status = document.createElement("td");
      var st = el("span", "status status-" + normalizeStatus(inc.status), inc.status);
      status.appendChild(st);

      tr.appendChild(sevCell);
      tr.appendChild(svc);
      tr.appendChild(title);
      tr.appendChild(age);
      tr.appendChild(owner);
      tr.appendChild(status);

      body.appendChild(tr);
    });

    renderDetail();
  }

  function renderDetail() {
    var detailBody = document.getElementById("detail-body");
    detailBody.textContent = "";

    if (!state.selectedId) {
      detailBody.appendChild(el("p", "detail-placeholder", "Select an incident to view details."));
      return;
    }

    var inc = state.incidents.find(function (i) { return i.id === state.selectedId; });
    if (!inc) {
      detailBody.appendChild(el("p", "detail-placeholder", "Select an incident to view details."));
      return;
    }

    detailBody.appendChild(el("h3", "detail-title", inc.title));
    detailBody.appendChild(el("div", "detail-id", inc.id));

    var sevLine = el("div", "detail-row");
    sevLine.appendChild(el("span", null, "Severity"));
    var sevVal = el("span", "sev sev-" + inc.severity, inc.severity);
    sevLine.appendChild(sevVal);
    detailBody.appendChild(sevLine);

    var svcLine = el("div", "detail-row");
    svcLine.appendChild(el("span", null, "Service"));
    svcLine.appendChild(el("span", null, inc.service));
    detailBody.appendChild(svcLine);

    var ageLine = el("div", "detail-row");
    ageLine.appendChild(el("span", null, "Age"));
    ageLine.appendChild(el("span", null, inc.age));
    detailBody.appendChild(ageLine);

    var ownerLine = el("div", "detail-row");
    ownerLine.appendChild(el("span", null, "Owner"));
    ownerLine.appendChild(el("span", null, inc.owner));
    detailBody.appendChild(ownerLine);

    var statusLine = el("div", "detail-row");
    statusLine.appendChild(el("span", null, "Status"));
    statusLine.appendChild(el("span", "status status-" + normalizeStatus(inc.status), inc.status));
    detailBody.appendChild(statusLine);

    var btn = el("button", "ack-btn", "Acknowledge");
    btn.type = "button";
    if (normalizeStatus(inc.status) === "acknowledged") {
      btn.classList.add("is-acked");
      btn.textContent = "Acknowledged";
      btn.disabled = true;
    }
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () { acknowledge(inc.id); });
    detailBody.appendChild(btn);
  }

  function acknowledge(id) {
    var inc = state.incidents.find(function (i) { return i.id === id; });
    if (!inc) return;
    inc.status = "acknowledged";
    renderTable();
    if (document.getElementById("status-filter").value === "all" ||
        document.getElementById("status-filter").value === "acknowledged") {
      selectRow(id);
    }
    var orig = inc.owner;
    showToast("Acknowledged " + id + (orig && orig !== "Unassigned" ? " (" + orig + ")" : ""));
  }

  function selectRow(id) {
    state.selectedId = id;
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll("#incident-body tr");
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var selected = r.getAttribute("data-id") === id;
      r.classList.toggle("is-selected", selected);
      r.setAttribute("aria-selected", selected ? "true" : "false");
    });
    renderDetail();
  }

  function showToast(msg) {
    var existing = document.querySelector(".toast");
    if (existing) existing.remove();
    var t = el("div", "toast", msg);
    t.setAttribute("role", "status");
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 2600);
  }

  /* ----- clock ----- */
  function tick() {
    var now = new Date();
    var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; };
    var str = pad(now.getUTCHours()) + ":" + pad(now.getUTCMinutes()) + " UTC";
    var clock = document.getElementById("clock");
    if (clock) clock.textContent = str;
  }

  /* ----- events ----- */
  function bind() {
    document.getElementById("sev-filter").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
      state.filters.severity = e.target.value;
      renderTable();
    });
    document.getElementById("status-filter").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
      state.filters.status = e.target.value;
      renderTable();
    });
    document.getElementById("search-filter").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
      state.filters.query = e.target.value;
      renderTable();
    });

    document.getElementById("incident-body").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var tr = e.target.closest("tr");
      if (tr && tr.getAttribute("data-id")) selectRow(tr.getAttribute("data-id"));
    });
    document.getElementById("incident-body").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
        var tr = e.target.closest("tr");
        if (tr && tr.getAttribute("data-id")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectRow(tr.getAttribute("data-id"));
        }
      }
    });
  }

  /* ----- init ----- */
  function init() {
    bind();
    tick();
    setInterval(tick, 30000);

    loadData()
      .then(function (data) {
        state.incidents = data.incidents;
        renderMetrics(data.metrics);
        renderChart(data.throughput);
        renderTable();
      })
      .catch(function () {
        var body = document.getElementById("incident-body");
        body.appendChild(el("tr"));
        document.getElementById("empty-state").hidden = false;
        document.getElementById("empty-state").textContent = "Unable to load incident data.";
      });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Relay — Operations</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>

  <div class="app">
    <aside class="rail" aria-label="Primary navigation">
      <div class="rail-brand" aria-hidden="true">R</div>
      <nav class="rail-nav">
        <a href="#metrics" class="rail-item is-active" aria-current="page" title="Overview">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4" y="4" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="4" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="4" y="14" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a href="#incidents" class="rail-item" title="Incidents">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l8 14H4l8-14z"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a href="#throughput" class="rail-item" title="Throughput">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 21h18M5 17l4-5 3 3 5-7"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a href="#team" class="rail-item" title="Team">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3"/><circle cx="17" cy="9" r="2.5"/><path d="M3 20c0-3 2.5-5 6-5s6 2 6 5"/></svg>
        </a>
      </nav>
      <div class="rail-foot">
        <a href="#settings" class="rail-item" title="Settings">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M4.3 4.3l2.1 2.1M17.6 17.6l2.1 2.1M19.7 4.3l-2.1 2.1M6.4 17.6l-2.1 2.1"/></svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <header class="topbar" aria-label="Status bar">
      <div class="topbar-left">
        <span class="brand-name">Relay</span>
        <span class="crumb">/</span>
        <span class="crumb-current">Operations</span>
      </div>
      <div class="topbar-center">
        <span class="env-pill">prod</span>
        <span class="sync"><span class="status-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span> Live</span>
        <time id="clock" class="clock" datetime="2026-10-11T22:41:00Z">22:41 UTC</time>
      </div>
      <div class="topbar-right">
        <span class="region">us-east-1</span>
        <span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">OP</span>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main id="main" class="content">
      <section id="metrics" class="section" aria-labelledby="metrics-h">
        <h2 id="metrics-h" class="section-h">Summary</h2>
        <div class="metric-grid" role="list">
          <article class="metric" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="metric-label" id="m0-label">Events / min</span>
            <span class="metric-value" data-metric="0">—</span>
            <span class="trend trend-up">—</span>
          </article>
          <article class="metric" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="metric-label" id="m1-label">P95 latency</span>
            <span class="metric-value" data-metric="1">—</span>
            <span class="trend trend-down">—</span>
          </article>
          <article class="metric" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="metric-label" id="m2-label">Error rate</span>
            <span class="metric-value" data-metric="2">—</span>
            <span class="trend trend-up">—</span>
          </article>
          <article class="metric" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="metric-label" id="m3-label">Queue depth</span>
            <span class="metric-value" data-metric="3">—</span>
            <span class="trend trend-down">—</span>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="throughput" class="section" aria-labelledby="throughput-h">
        <h2 id="throughput-h" class="section-h">24-hour throughput</h2>
        <div class="panel">
          <svg id="spark" class="chart" viewBox="0 0 720 220" role="img" aria-label="Requests per minute over the last 24 hours"></svg>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="incidents" class="section" aria-labelledby="incidents-h">
        <div class="section-header">
          <h2 id="incidents-h" class="section-h">Incidents</h2>
          <div class="filter-bar" role="group" aria-label="Filter incidents">
            <label class="filter-label" for="sev-filter">Severity</label>
            <select id="sev-filter">
              <option value="all">All</option>
              <option value="critical">Critical</option>
              <option value="high">High</option>
              <option value="medium">Medium</option>
              <option value="low">Low</option>
            </select>
            <label class="filter-label" for="status-filter">Status</label>
            <select id="status-filter">
              <option value="all">All</option>
              <option value="investigating">Investigating</option>
              <option value="open">Open</option>
              <option value="monitoring">Monitoring</option>
              <option value="acknowledged">Acknowledged</option>
            </select>
            <label class="filter-label" for="search-filter">Search</label>
            <input id="search-filter" type="search" placeholder="Service, owner, id…">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="incident-layout">
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table class="incident-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col">Severity</th>
                  <th scope="col">Service</th>
                  <th scope="col">Title</th>
                  <th scope="col">Age</th>
                  <th scope="col">Owner</th>
                  <th scope="col">Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody id="incident-body"></tbody>
            </table>
            <p id="empty-state" class="empty-state" hidden>No incidents match the current filters.</p>
          </div>

          <aside class="detail" id="detail" aria-live="polite">
            <h3 class="detail-h">Incident detail</h3>
            <div id="detail-body">
              <p class="detail-placeholder">Select an incident to view details.</p>
            </div>
          </aside>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="team" class="section" aria-labelledby="team-h">
        <h2 id="team-h" class="section-h">On-call</h2>
        <div class="panel" id="team-panel">
          <p class="placeholder">On-call roster loads here.</p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="settings" class="section visually-hidden" aria-labelledby="settings-h">
        <h2 id="settings-h">Settings</h2>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

deepseek-v4-pro/11-frontend-operations/styles.css

:root {
  --bg: #121519;
  --bg-raised: #1a1e24;
  --bg-panel: #1c2128;
  --border: #2a313b;
  --border-soft: #242a33;
  --text: #d7dce3;
  --text-dim: #8b94a3;
  --text-faint: #5c6572;
  --accent: #2f81f7;
  --accent-soft: rgba(47, 129, 247, 0.14);
  --ok: #31a86b;
  --warn: #d8a53a;
  --err: #d53f4f;
  --crit: #e5484d;
  --high: #ed7d31;
  --medium: #d8a53a;
  --low: #5c7fbf;
  --focus: #7fb2ff;
  --rail-w: 60px;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

.app {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--rail-w) 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 48px 1fr;
  grid-template-areas: "rail topbar" "rail content";
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* ---------- focus ---------- */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 8px;
  top: -40px;
  z-index: 100;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: top 0.15s ease;
}
.skip-link:focus {
  top: 8px;
}

/* ---------- skip link ---------- */
.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px; height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

a:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, button:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ---------- rail ---------- */
.rail {
  grid-area: rail;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 0;
}

.rail-brand {
  width: 34px; height: 34px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.rail-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex: 1; }
.rail-foot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.rail-item {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  background: transparent;
}
.rail-item:hover { background: var(--border-soft); color: var(--text); }
.rail-item.is-active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.rail-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; }
.rail-brand, .rail-item rect, .rail-item circle, .rail-item path { }

/* ---------- top bar ---------- */
.topbar {
  grid-area: topbar;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.brand-name { font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.crumb, .crumb-current { color: var(--text-faint); }
.crumb { margin: 0 6px; }

.topbar-center { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.topbar-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }

.env-pill {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
}

.sync { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px; }
.status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok); }
.clock { color: var(--text-dim); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; }
.region { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px; }
.avatar {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--border); color: var(--text-dim);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
}

/* ---------- content ---------- */
.content {
  grid-area: content;
  padding: 20px 24px 40px;
  max-width: 1280px;
  width: 100%;
}

.section { margin-bottom: 32px; }
.section-h {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--text-faint);
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.section-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

/* ---------- metrics ---------- */
.metric-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1px;
  background: var(--border);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.metric {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.metric:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }
.metric-label { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px; }
.metric-value {
  font-size: 26px; font-weight: 650;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--text);
}
.trend { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; }
.trend-up { color: var(--err); }
.trend-down { color: var(--ok); }
.trend::before { content: ""; margin-right: 4px; }
.trend-up::before { content: "▲"; font-size: 9px; }
.trend-down::before { content: "▼"; font-size: 9px; }

/* ---------- panels / chart ---------- */
.panel {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px;
}
.chart { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.chart .axis { stroke: var(--border); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart .gridline { stroke: var(--border-soft); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart .area { fill: var(--accent-soft); }
.chart .line { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2; fill: none; }
.chart .dot { fill: var(--accent); }
.chart .label { fill: var(--text-faint); font-size: 10px; }
.placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); margin: 8px 0; }

/* ---------- filters ---------- */
.filter-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.filter-label { color: var(--text-faint); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

select, input[type="search"] {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-family: inherit;
}
input[type="search"] { min-width: 150px; }
input[type="search"]::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); }

/* ---------- incident layout ---------- */
.incident-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: start;
}
.table-wrap {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.incident-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.incident-table th, .incident-table td {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
  font-size: 13px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.incident-table th {
  color: var(--text-faint);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
}
.incident-table tbody tr { cursor: pointer; }
.incident-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--border-soft); }
.incident-table tbody tr.is-selected { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.incident-table tbody tr.is-selected td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.incident-table td.num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.sev {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px;
}
.sev::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; }
.sev-critical { color: var(--crit); }
.sev-critical::before { background: var(--crit); }
.sev-high { color: var(--high); }
.sev-high::before { background: var(--high); }
.sev-medium { color: var(--medium); }
.sev-medium::before { background: var(--medium); }
.sev-low { color: var(--low); }
.sev-low::before { background: var(--low); }

.status { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: capitalize; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; }
.status-investigating { color: var(--err); background: rgba(213, 63, 79, 0.14); }
.status-open { color: var(--warn); background: rgba(216, 165, 58, 0.14); }
.status-monitoring { color: var(--ok); background: rgba(49, 168, 107, 0.14); }
.status-acknowledged { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }

.empty-state { color: var(--text-faint); padding: 24px 16px; text-align: center; }

/* ---------- detail panel ---------- */
.detail {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 68px;
}
.detail-h {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--text-faint); margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.detail-placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); }
.detail-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0 0 4px; }
.detail-id { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.detail dl { margin: 0; }
.detail dt { color: var(--text-faint); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.detail dd { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13px; }
.detail-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); padding-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.detail-row span:first-child { color: var(--text-faint); }
.detail-row span:last-child { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.ack-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border: none; border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
}
.ack-btn:hover { background: #3d8cf8; }
.ack-btn.is-acked { background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim); border: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: default; }

.toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px; right: 20px;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--ok);
  color: var(--text);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

/* ---------- mobile ---------- */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .app {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 48px auto 1fr;
    grid-template-areas: "rail" "topbar" "content";
  }
  .rail {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 12px;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .rail-brand { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .rail-nav, .rail-foot { flex-direction: row; gap: 2px; }
  .rail-foot { display: flex; }
  .topbar-center { display: none; }
  .content { padding: 16px 12px 32px; }
  .metric-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .incident-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .detail { position: static; }
  .section-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  .incident-table th, .incident-table td { padding: 8px; }
  .incident-table th:nth-child(3), .incident-table td:nth-child(3) { display: none; }
  .incident-table th:nth-child(5), .incident-table td:nth-child(5) { display: none; }
}

Evaluation 5.5 / 10 graded blind as submission O

Compact dark dashboard whose 'No incidents match the current filters.' block is always visible below the rows. At 390 px the icon rail stays on screen and the table is squeezed into an internal scroll; first Tab stop is the Acknowledge button.

Strengths

  • Filters and acknowledge work; row status becomes 'Acknowledged'
  • Dense, aligned desktop table

Weaknesses

  • Empty state shown on initial load with all incidents present
  • Mobile keeps a 48px rail, table cramped (table-wrap 443/320), owner column cut
  • No skip link; tab order begins in the detail panel; icon-only nav; 23 low-contrast nodes
  • Severity dots missing on some rows; focus lost after ack
Evidence the grader checked
  • probe.js emptyVisibleInitially=['No incidents match the current filters.']
  • focus walk starts 'BUT:Acknowledge > BUT:Mark resolve > BUT:Overview'
  • O-mobile-full.png
  • probe.js/probe2.js (Playwright, 1440x900 and 390x844, served over 127.0.0.1)

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0
