        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric" data-metric="queue">
        <div class="metric-label">Queue depth</div>
        <div class="metric-value">2,841</div>
        <div class="metric-trend trend-down" aria-label="Down 19% from previous period">
          <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none"/></svg>
          <span>−19%</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="throughput" aria-label="24-hour throughput">
      <div class="panel-header">
        <h2>Throughput (24h)</h2>
        <div class="panel-controls">
          <select id="throughput-scale" aria-label="Y-axis scale">
            <option value="linear">Linear</option>
            <option value="log">Logarithmic</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-wrapper" role="img" aria-label="Line chart showing events per hour over 24 hours, ranging from 20 to 88 events per minute">
        <canvas id="throughput-chart" width="800" height="200" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
        <div class="chart-y-axis" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div class="chart-x-axis" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-legend" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-color" style="--color: var(--accent)"></span>Events/min</span>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="lower-section">
      <section class="incidents-panel" aria-label="Incidents">
        <div class="panel-header">
          <h2>Active Incidents</h2>
          <div class="panel-controls">
            <div class="filter-group">
              <label for="severity-filter" class="visually-hidden">Filter by severity</label>
              <select id="severity-filter" aria-label="Filter by severity">
                <option value="">All severities</option>
                <option value="critical">Critical</option>
                <option value="high">High</option>
                <option value="medium">Medium</option>
                <option value="low">Low</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="filter-group">
              <label for="status-filter" class="visually-hidden">Filter by status</label>
              <select id="status-filter" aria-label="Filter by status">
                <option value="">All statuses</option>
                <option value="open">Open</option>
                <option value="investigating">Investigating</option>
                <option value="monitoring">Monitoring</option>
                <option value="resolved">Resolved</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="filter-group">
              <label for="service-filter" class="visually-hidden">Filter by service</label>
              <select id="service-filter" aria-label="Filter by service">
                <option value="">All services</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <button id="clear-filters" class="btn btn-ghost" aria-label="Clear all filters">Clear</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="table-wrapper" role="region" aria-label="Incident table" tabindex="0">
          <table id="incidents-table" class="incidents-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">ID</th>
                <th scope="col">Severity</th>
                <th scope="col">Service</th>
                <th scope="col">Age</th>
                <th scope="col">Owner</th>
                <th scope="col">Status</th>
                <th scope="col">Title</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="incidents-body">
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <div id="empty-state" class="empty-state" hidden>
            <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="12" cy="16" r="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
            <p>No incidents match current filters</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <aside class="detail-panel" aria-label="Incident details" role="complementary">
        <div class="panel-header">
          <h2>Incident Detail</h2>
        </div>
        <div id="detail-content" class="detail-content">
          <div class="detail-empty">
            <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M9 9h6M9 13h6M9 17h4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
            <p>Select an incident from the table to view details</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="detail-loaded" class="detail-loaded" hidden>
          <div class="detail-header">
            <div class="detail-id-severity">
              <span id="detail-id" class="detail-id"></span>
              <span id="detail-severity" class="severity-badge"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="detail-status-row">
              <span id="detail-status" class="status-badge"></span>
              <span id="detail-age" class="detail-age"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <h3 id="detail-title" class="detail-title"></h3>
          <dl class="detail-meta">
            <div class="meta-row">
              <dt>Service</dt>
              <dd id="detail-service"></dd>
            </div>
            <div class="meta-row">
              <dt>Owner</dt>
              <dd id="detail-owner"></dd>
            </div>
            <div class="meta-row">
              <dt>Created</dt>
              <dd id="detail-created"></dd>
            </div>
            <div class="meta-row">
              <dt>Last update</dt>
              <dd id="detail-updated"></dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <div class="detail-description">
            <h4>Description</h4>
            <p id="detail-description-text"></p>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-timeline" aria-label="Activity timeline">
            <h4>Timeline</h4>
            <ul id="detail-timeline" class="timeline"></ul>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-actions">
            <button id="acknowledge-btn" class="btn btn-primary" aria-label="Acknowledge incident">Acknowledge</button>
            <button id="resolve-btn" class="btn btn-ghost" aria-label="Resolve incident">Resolve</button>
            <button id="escalate-btn" class="btn btn-ghost" aria-label="Escalate incident">Escalate</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </main>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

nemotron-3-ultra/11-frontend-operations/styles.css

:root {
  --bg: #0f1115;
  --bg-elevated: #16191f;
  --bg-hover: #1c2028;
  --bg-active: #222831;
  --border: #2a2f3a;
  --border-strong: #353b48;
  --fg: #e8eaed;
  --fg-muted: #9aa3af;
  --fg-subtle: #6b7280;
  --accent: #00d4aa;
  --accent-dim: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.15);
  --accent-strong: #00e8bb;
  --critical: #ff4d6a;
  --critical-dim: rgba(255, 77, 106, 0.15);
  --high: #ffb84d;
  --high-dim: rgba(255, 184, 77, 0.15);
  --medium: #4db8ff;
  --medium-dim: rgba(77, 184, 255, 0.15);
  --low: #8b95a1;
  --low-dim: rgba(139, 149, 161, 0.15);
  --success: #00d4aa;
  --warning: #ffb84d;
  --danger: #ff4d6a;
  --mono: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Monaco', 'Consolas', monospace;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  --rail-width: 72px;
  --rail-width-expanded: 220px;
  --topbar-height: 48px;
  --radius: 6px;
  --radius-sm: 4px;
  --transition-fast: 120ms ease;
  --transition-normal: 200ms ease;
  --shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root {
    --bg: #f8f9fb;
    --bg-elevated: #ffffff;
    --bg-hover: #f0f2f5;
    --bg-active: #e8ebef;
    --border: #e1e4eb;
    --border-strong: #d0d5dd;
    --fg: #1d2129;
    --fg-muted: #5c6573;
    --fg-subtle: #8c95a1;
    --accent: #00a884;
    --accent-dim: rgba(0, 168, 132, 0.12);
    --accent-strong: #00c096;
    --critical: #d92d20;
    --critical-dim: rgba(217, 45, 32, 0.12);
    --high: #c47600;
    --high-dim: rgba(196, 118, 0, 0.12);
    --medium: #0078d4;
    --medium-dim: rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.12);
    --low: #6b7280;
    --low-dim: rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.12);
    --shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    --focus-ring: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-elevated), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent);
  }
}

*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: 13px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--rail-width) 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: var(--topbar-height) 1fr;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

a { color: var(--accent); }
a:hover { color: var(--accent-strong); }

.rail {
  grid-row: 1 / -1;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 12px 8px;
  gap: 4px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 100;
  transition: width var(--transition-normal);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rail-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 4px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  opacity: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-fast);
}

.rail-logo {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  color: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rail-title {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.rail:hover .rail-brand,
.rail:focus-within .rail-brand {
  opacity: 1;
}

.rail-items {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  flex: 1;
}

.rail-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
}

.rail-item svg {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.rail-item:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--fg);
}

.rail-item.active {
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.rail-item.active svg {
  stroke: var(--accent);
}

.rail-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 8px;
}

.topbar {
  grid-column: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: var(--topbar-height);
  padding: 0 20px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: 20px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 50;
}

.topbar-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.topbar-hamburger {
  display: none;
  padding: 8px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--fg);
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  transition: background var(--transition-fast);
}

.topbar-hamburger:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
}

.topbar-hamburger svg {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.topbar-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.topbar-center {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  max-width: 400px;
}

.status-indicator {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.status-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--success);
  animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(0.9); }
}

.topbar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.topbar-time {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  min-width: 100px;
  text-align: center;
}

.topbar-user {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--fg);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.topbar-user:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.topbar-user svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.main {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 2;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: 0;
}

.metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.metric {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}

.metric:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.metric-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
}

.metric-value {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.metric-trend {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

.metric-trend svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.trend-up { color: var(--critical); }
.trend-down { color: var(--success); }

.throughput {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.panel-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.panel-header h2 {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.panel-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.chart-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  height: 200px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden;
}

#throughput-chart {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.chart-y-axis {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 28px;
  width: 56px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 8px 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.chart-y-axis span {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  text-align: right;
  padding-right: 8px;
  height: 1em;
  line-height: 1;
}

.chart-x-axis {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 56px;
  right: 0;
  height: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding-top: 4px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.chart-x-axis span {
  flex: 1;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.chart-legend {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 4px 4px 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
}

.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.legend-color {
  width: 16px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--color);
}

.lower-section {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: 0;
}

.incidents-panel {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
}

.incidents-panel .panel-header {
  padding: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.filter-group select {
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--fg);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  min-width: 130px;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.filter-group select:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.filter-group select:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.table-wrapper {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  position: relative;
}

.table-wrapper:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent);
}

.incidents-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.incidents-table thead {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
}

.incidents-table th {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.incidents-table td {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  vertical-align: middle;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.incidents-table tbody tr {
  transition: background var(--transition-fast);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.incidents-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
}

.incidents-table tbody tr.selected {
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  outline: 1px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}

.incidents-table td:first-child {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.severity-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.severity-critical { background: var(--critical-dim); color: var(--critical); }
.severity-high { background: var(--high-dim); color: var(--high); }
.severity-medium { background: var(--medium-dim); color: var(--medium); }
.severity-low { background: var(--low-dim); color: var(--low); }

.status-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: capitalize;
}

.status-open { background: var(--medium-dim); color: var(--medium); }
.status-investigating { background: var(--high-dim); color: var(--high); }
.status-monitoring { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }
.status-resolved { background: var(--low-dim); color: var(--low); }
.status-acknowledged { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }

.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 48px 24px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  text-align: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.empty-state svg {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.empty-state p {
  font-size: 13px;
}

.detail-panel {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: calc(100vh - var(--topbar-height) - 52px);
}

.detail-panel .panel-header {
  padding: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.detail-content {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 24px;
}

.detail-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 200px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  text-align: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.detail-empty svg {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.detail-empty p {
  font-size: 13px;
  max-width: 200px;
}

.detail-loaded {
  padding: 24px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  animation: fadeIn var(--transition-normal);
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.detail-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.detail-id-severity {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.detail-id {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.detail-status-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.detail-age {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
}

.detail-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.detail-meta {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.detail-meta dt {
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.detail-meta dd {
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

.detail-description {
  padding-top: 8px;
}

.detail-description h4 {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.detail-description p {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.detail-timeline {
  padding-top: 8px;
}

.detail-timeline h4 {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.timeline {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.timeline li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-left: 14px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--border);
  position: relative;
}

.timeline li::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -5px;
  top: 4px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--border);
  border: 2px solid var(--bg-elevated);
}

.timeline li:last-child::before {
  background: var(--accent);
}

.timeline-time {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-subtle);
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 60px;
}

.timeline-content {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.timeline-event {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.timeline-detail {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.detail-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--bg);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  flex: 1;
}

.btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--accent-strong);
  border-color: var(--accent-strong);
}

.btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) {
  background: #00b894;
}

.btn-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fg);
  border-color: var(--border);
  flex: 1;
}

.btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.btn-ghost:active:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--bg-active);
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .metrics {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .lower-section {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .detail-panel {
    max-height: none;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius) var(--radius);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  body {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: var(--topbar-height) auto 1fr;
  }

  .rail {
    grid-row: 2;
    grid-column: 1;
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .rail-brand {
    opacity: 1;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .rail-items {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .rail-item span {
    display: none;
  }

  .rail-item {
    padding: 8px;
    min-width: 40px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .rail-footer {
    display: none;
  }

  .topbar {
    grid-row: 1;
    grid-column: 1;
  }

  .topbar-hamburger {
    display: flex;
  }

  .topbar-title {
    display: none;
  }

  .topbar-center {
    display: none;
  }

  .main {
    grid-row: 3;
    grid-column: 1;
    padding: 12px;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .metrics {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .metric-value {
    font-size: 24px;
  }

  .panel-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .panel-controls {
    width: 100%;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .filter-group {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 140px;
  }

  .filter-group select {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .incidents-table th:nth-child(5),
  .incidents-table td:nth-child(5),
  .incidents-table th:nth-child(6),
  .incidents-table td:nth-child(6) {
    display: none;
  }

  .detail-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .btn {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 390px) {
  html {
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .topbar {
    padding: 0 12px;
  }

  .main {
    padding: 10px;
  }

  .metric {
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .metric-value {
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .throughput {
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .chart-wrapper {
    height: 160px;
  }

  .incidents-panel .panel-header,
  .detail-panel .panel-header {
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .incidents-table th,
  .incidents-table td {
    padding: 8px 10px;
  }

  .filter-group select {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .detail-content,
  .detail-loaded {
    padding: 16px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }

  .status-dot {
    animation: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-contrast: high) {
  :root {
    --border: currentColor;
    --border-strong: currentColor;
    --bg-hover: transparent;
    --bg-active: transparent;
    --accent-dim: transparent;
    --critical-dim: transparent;
    --high-dim: transparent;
    --medium-dim: transparent;
    --low-dim: transparent;
  }

  .metric:hover {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px currentColor;
  }

  .incidents-table tbody tr.selected {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px currentColor;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    background: transparent;
    border-width: 2px;
  }

  .btn-ghost {
    border-width: 2px;
  }
}
